-- Noir UI · NovaUI · MM2 — full stitched build
-- Assembled from Part 1/2/3 (deobfuscated from NRX2 wrappers).
-- Load order is significant: Part 1 bootstraps NoirGenv().__NoirCore;
-- Parts 2 and 3 register their satellites against that shared core.
-- Run once; the Noir guard/heartbeat keeps state warm across respawns.


-- ============================================================================
-- PART 1/3 — Noir UI core (window, tabs, controls, configs, persistence, guard)
-- ============================================================================

-- Noir UI • NovaUI Part 1/3 (MM2 core) • rebuilt on the Noir menu library:
-- the window, tabs and every control are Noir UI elements now; settings
-- save through Noir configs (Noir UI/NoirConfigs) and NoirPersistence.
local function __noirW1a()
-- Noir MM2 — asset loader (deobf pass 1: base64 -> external files)
-- All embedded PNG/JSON blobs were extracted to noir_assets/ and are read
-- at runtime. Falls back to inline base64 decode only if readfile is unavailable.
local __noirAssetCache = {}
local __noirAssetB64Fallback = {}  -- populated lazily for offline cases
local __noirAssetDir = "noir_assets"
-- [FIX] track missing assets so we can warn the user instead of silently
-- disabling features. Exposed via NoirGenv().__NoirAssetStatus so satellites
-- can decide whether to skip work that needs an asset.
local __noirAssetStatus = { missing = {}, loaded = {}, total = 0, dir = __noirAssetDir }
local function __noirDecodeB64(s)
    local fn = (type(crypt) == "table" and crypt.base64decode)
        or (type(crypt) == "table" and crypt.base64_decode)
        or (type(base64decode) == "function" and base64decode)
        or (type(decrypt) == "function" and decrypt)
    if fn then return fn(s) end
    if type(HttpService) == "Instance" and HttpService.Base64Decode then
        return HttpService:Base64Decode(s)
    end
    return nil
end
local function __noirAsset(name)
    if __noirAssetCache[name] ~= nil then return __noirAssetCache[name] end
    __noirAssetStatus.total = __noirAssetStatus.total + 1
    local raw
    if type(readfile) == "function" then
        local ok, data = pcall(readfile, __noirAssetDir .. "/" .. name)
        if ok and type(data) == "string" and #data > 0 then raw = data end
    end
    if not raw then
        local b64 = __noirAssetB64Fallback[name]
        if b64 then raw = __noirDecodeB64(b64) end
    end
    local result
    if raw then
        if name:sub(-5) == ".json" then
            local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
                if type(HttpService) == "Instance" then
                    return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
                end
            end)
            result = ok and decoded or raw
        else
            -- PNG: hand it to the executor's custom-asset pipeline if available
            local getasset = (type(getcustomasset) == "function" and getcustomasset)
                or (type(getsynasset) == "function" and getsynasset)
            if getasset and type(writefile) == "function" then
                local path = __noirAssetDir .. "/" .. name
                pcall(writefile, path, raw)
                -- [FIX] pcall getasset: some executors throw on a malformed asset
                local okAsset, asset = pcall(getasset, path)
                result = (okAsset and type(asset) == "string") and asset or raw
            else
                result = raw
            end
        end
        __noirAssetStatus.loaded[name] = true
    else
        __noirAssetStatus.missing[name] = true
    end
    __noirAssetCache[name] = result
    return result
end

-- [FIX] expose status so satellites can short-circuit gracefully
pcall(function()
    local g = (type(NoirGenv) == "function") and NoirGenv() or nil
    if type(g) == "table" then
        g.__NoirAssetStatus = __noirAssetStatus
        -- [FIX] expose __noirAsset itself: the Skin satellite (compiled via
        -- loadstring with ENV { __index = _G }) calls __noirAsset("SKINS_DB_B64.json")
        -- but __noirAsset is a local here — without this export the satellite
        -- throws "attempt to call a nil value" and the entire skinchanger tab
        -- fails to start.
        g.__noirAsset = __noirAsset
        g.__noirAssetB64Fallback = __noirAssetB64Fallback
        g.__noirAssetDir = __noirAssetDir
    end
end)

-- [FIX] one-shot deferred diagnostic so the user sees WHAT is missing
local __noirAssetReported = false
local function __noirReportMissingAssets()
    if __noirAssetReported then return end
    __noirAssetReported = true
    local m = __noirAssetStatus.missing
    local count = 0
    for _ in pairs(m) do count = count + 1 end
    if count == 0 then return end
    local lines = {
        "[Noir] WARNING: " .. count .. " asset(s) missing — features that depend on them are disabled.",
        "[Noir] Expected asset directory: " .. __noirAssetDir .. "/  (next to the script in your executor workspace)",
    }
    for name in pairs(m) do
        lines[#lines + 1] = "  - missing: " .. name
    end
    lines[#lines + 1] = "[Noir] Loaded assets: " .. (function()
        local n = 0 for _ in pairs(__noirAssetStatus.loaded) do n = n + 1 end return n
    end)()
    local msg = table.concat(lines, "\n")
    pcall(function() warn(msg) end)
    pcall(function()
        local g = (type(NoirGenv) == "function") and NoirGenv() or nil
        if type(g) == "table" then g.__NoirAssetWarning = msg end
    end)
end
-- defer the report so all __noirAsset() calls during startup have run first
pcall(function()
    if type(task) == "table" and type(task.defer) == "function" then
        task.defer(function()
            if type(task) == "table" and type(task.wait) == "function" then task.wait(0.5) end
            __noirReportMissingAssets()
        end)
    end
end)

    NoirGenv = function()
        if type(getgenv) == "function" then
            local ok, t = pcall(getgenv)
            if ok and type(t) == "table" then return t end
        end
        return _G
    end
end
if type(NoirTr) ~= "function" then
    NoirTr = function(s)
        if type(s) ~= "string" then return s end
        local st = NoirGenv().__NoirLangState
        local dict = st and st.dicts and st.dicts[st.lang]
        if type(dict) == "table" then return dict[s] or s end
        if st and st.lang == "ru" then return (st.dict or {})[s] or s end
        return s
    end
end
if type(NoirGenv().__NoirLangState) ~= "table" then
    NoirGenv().__NoirLangState = { lang = "en", dict = {}, dicts = {}, renderedToSource = {}, originalTextDirections = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) }
end

-- Safe TweenService: if the target Instance is already destroyed (page rebuilt,
-- element cleared) Create() used to throw "Instance is null" into the console.
local __NoirRealTweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local function __NoirDeadTween()
    local proxy
    proxy = setmetatable({}, { __index = function() return function() return proxy end end })
    return proxy
end
local TweenService = setmetatable({}, {
    __index = function(_, key)
        if key ~= "Create" then return __NoirRealTweenService[key] end
        return function(_, inst, info, props)
            if typeof(inst) ~= "Instance" then return __NoirDeadTween() end
            local ok, tween = pcall(__NoirRealTweenService.Create, __NoirRealTweenService, inst, info, props)
            if not ok or type(tween) ~= "table" and typeof(tween) ~= "Instance" then return __NoirDeadTween() end
            return tween
        end
    end,
})

local NoirFX = (function()
    local fx, springs, spinners, spinAccum = { gui = nil }, {}, {}, 0
    fx.RING = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(3, 10, 14)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.25, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 248)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.5, Color3.fromRGB(3, 10, 14)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.75, Color3.fromRGB(53, 116, 115)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(3, 10, 14)),
    })
    function fx.new(initial, speed, damp, apply)
        local sp = { pos = initial, vel = 0, target = initial, speed = speed, damp = math.min(damp, 1), apply = apply }
        function sp:Set(v) self.target = v; springs[self] = true end
        function sp:Snap(v) self.pos, self.target, self.vel = v, v, 0; springs[self] = nil; apply(v) end
        apply(initial)
        return sp
    end
    function fx.spin(gradient) spinners[#spinners + 1] = gradient; return gradient end
    local conn
    conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if fx.gui and not fx.gui.Parent then conn:Disconnect() return end
        dt = math.min(dt, 1 / 20)
        -- OPTIM: спиннеры обновляются на 30 FPS вместо каждого кадра — визуально идентично, нагрузка вдвое ниже
        spinAccum += dt
        if spinAccum >= 1 / 30 then
            local rot = 60 * spinAccum
            spinAccum = 0
            for _, g in ipairs(spinners) do g.Rotation = (g.Rotation + rot) % 360 end
        end
        local list = {}
        for sp in pairs(springs) do list[#list + 1] = sp end
        for _, sp in ipairs(list) do
            local w, d = sp.speed, sp.damp
            local x0, v0 = sp.pos - sp.target, sp.vel
            local x, v
            if d >= 1 then
                local e = math.exp(-w * dt)
                x = (x0 + (v0 + w * x0) * dt) * e
                v = (v0 - (v0 + w * x0) * w * dt) * e
            else
                local c = math.sqrt(1 - d * d)
                local i, j = math.cos(c * w * dt), math.sin(c * w * dt)
                local e = math.exp(-d * w * dt)
                x = (x0 * (i + d / c * j) + v0 * j / (c * w)) * e
                v = (v0 * (i - d / c * j) - x0 * w / c * j) * e
            end
            sp.pos, sp.vel = x + sp.target, v
            if math.abs(x) < .001 and math.abs(v) < .001 then sp.pos, sp.vel = sp.target, 0; springs[sp] = nil end
            sp.apply(sp.pos)
        end
    end)
    return fx
end)()

 
local function __noirSharedEnvironment()
    local ok, environment = pcall(function()
        if type(getgenv) == "function" then return NoirGenv() end
    end)
    if ok and type(environment) == "table" then return environment end
    return _G
end
local __NOIR_SHARED = __noirSharedEnvironment()
local __NOIR_GUARD_KEY = "__NoirHubRuntimeLock"
local __NOIR_OLD_GUARD = __NOIR_SHARED[__NOIR_GUARD_KEY]
local function __noirGuardGuiAlive(record)
    if type(record) ~= "table" or not record.gui then return false end
    local ok, parent = pcall(function() return record.gui.Parent end)
    return ok and parent ~= nil
end
if type(__NOIR_OLD_GUARD) == "table" then
    local oldState = __NOIR_OLD_GUARD.state
    local age = os.clock() - (tonumber(__NOIR_OLD_GUARD.startedAt) or os.clock())
    local heartbeatAge = os.clock() - (tonumber(__NOIR_OLD_GUARD.heartbeat) or tonumber(__NOIR_OLD_GUARD.startedAt) or os.clock())
    if (oldState == "running" and (__noirGuardGuiAlive(__NOIR_OLD_GUARD) or heartbeatAge < 120))
        or (oldState == "starting" and (__noirGuardGuiAlive(__NOIR_OLD_GUARD) or age < 120)) then
        pcall(function() warn("[Noir] already starting/running; duplicate launch ignored") end)
        return
    end
    __NOIR_SHARED[__NOIR_GUARD_KEY] = nil
end
local __NOIR_GUARD = { state = "starting", startedAt = os.clock() }
__NOIR_SHARED[__NOIR_GUARD_KEY] = __NOIR_GUARD
task.delay(120, function()
    if __NOIR_SHARED[__NOIR_GUARD_KEY] == __NOIR_GUARD
        and __NOIR_GUARD.state == "starting"
        and not __noirGuardGuiAlive(__NOIR_GUARD) then
        __NOIR_SHARED[__NOIR_GUARD_KEY] = nil
    end
end)

local IS_TOUCH = UIS.TouchEnabled == true
local IS_KEYBOARD = UIS.KeyboardEnabled == true
local IS_MOUSE = UIS.MouseEnabled == true
local INPUT_DEVICE = (IS_TOUCH and not IS_MOUSE and not IS_KEYBOARD) and "Touch"
    or (IS_TOUCH and "Hybrid")
    or "Desktop"

local function isPrimaryPress(input)
    return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

local STORAGE_ROOT = "Noir UI"
local ASSETS_FOLDER = STORAGE_ROOT .. "/assets"
local CONFIGS_FOLDER = STORAGE_ROOT .. "/configs"
local PRESETS_FOLDER = STORAGE_ROOT .. "/presets"
local LEGACY_STORAGE_ROOT = "NOIR.CONFIG"

local function ensureFolder(path)
    if type(makefolder) ~= "function" then return end
    if type(isfolder) == "function" then
        local ok, exists = pcall(isfolder, path)
        if ok and exists then return end
    end
    pcall(makefolder, path)
end

local function ensureStorageFolders()
    ensureFolder(STORAGE_ROOT)
    ensureFolder(ASSETS_FOLDER)
    ensureFolder(CONFIGS_FOLDER)
    ensureFolder(PRESETS_FOLDER)
end

local function fileExists(path)
    if type(isfile) ~= "function" then return false end
    local ok, exists = pcall(isfile, path)
    return ok and exists == true
end

local function copyLegacyFile(source, destination)
    if type(readfile) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" then return end
    if not fileExists(source) or fileExists(destination) then return end
    local ok, contents = pcall(readfile, source)
    if ok then pcall(writefile, destination, contents) end
end

local function migrateLegacyStorage()
    copyLegacyFile(LEGACY_STORAGE_ROOT .. "/autosave.json", CONFIGS_FOLDER .. "/autosave.json")
    for _, name in ipairs({
        "ODH_FEAnimations_settings.json",
        "ODH_BJP_settings.json",
        "ODH_InventoryUnlimiter_settings.json",
        "ODH_Pm-Wallhop_settings.json",
    }) do
        copyLegacyFile(name, CONFIGS_FOLDER .. "/" .. name)
    end
    if type(listfiles) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" then return end
    local ok, files = pcall(listfiles, LEGACY_STORAGE_ROOT)
    if not ok or type(files) ~= "table" then return end
    for _, source in ipairs(files) do
        local normalized = tostring(source):gsub("\\", "/")
        local name = normalized:match("([^/]+%.preset)$")
        if name then copyLegacyFile(source, PRESETS_FOLDER .. "/" .. name) end
    end
end

ensureStorageFolders()
migrateLegacyStorage()

local guiParent = CoreGui
if type(gethui) == "function" then local ok,v=pcall(gethui); if ok and typeof(v)=="Instance" then guiParent=v end end
-- Необязательный переключатель родителя UI: NoirGenv().__NoirUIParent = "playergui"
-- ставит интерфейс в PlayerGui вместо CoreGui (убирает вмешательство в core-UI клиента).
do
    local pref
    pcall(function()
        local env = (type(NoirGenv) == "function") and NoirGenv() or nil
        if type(env) == "table" then pref = env.__NoirUIParent end
    end)
    if pref == "playergui" or pref == "player" or pref == "plrgui" then
        local playerGui = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if playerGui then guiParent = playerGui end
    end
end
local existingMainGui = guiParent:FindFirstChild("NoirSilentAimUI")
if not existingMainGui and guiParent ~= CoreGui then
    pcall(function() existingMainGui = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("NoirSilentAimUI") end)
end
if existingMainGui then
    -- Раньше здесь был return: новая версия молча не запускалась, а на экране
    -- оставался старый интерфейс. Теперь чистим прежние окна и строим заново.
    if __NOIR_SHARED[__NOIR_GUARD_KEY] == __NOIR_GUARD then __NOIR_SHARED[__NOIR_GUARD_KEY] = nil end
    local staleNames = {
        "NoirSilentAimUI", "MM2ShootMurdererButton", "NoirKnifeSheriffBind",
        "NoirGrabGunBindButton", "NoirAimlockOverlay", "NoirInvisibleBindButton",
        "NoirDesyncBindButton", "NoirEmotesButtons", "NoirEmotesQuick",
    }
    for _, root in ipairs({ guiParent, CoreGui, LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") }) do
        if root then
            for _, name in ipairs(staleNames) do
                local old = root:FindFirstChild(name)
                if old then pcall(function() old:Destroy() end) end
            end
        end
    end
    pcall(function() warn("[Noir] previous UI replaced with the current build") end)
end

function NoirPersistence.WriteNow()
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" then return end
    pcall(function()
        ensureStorageFolders()
        writefile(NoirPersistence.path, HttpService:JSONEncode(NoirPersistence.data))
    end)
end
function NoirPersistence.Save(immediate)
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" then return end
    NoirPersistence.dirty = true
    if immediate then
        NoirPersistence.WriteNow()
        NoirPersistence.dirty = false
        return
    end
    NoirPersistence.token += 1
    local token = NoirPersistence.token
    task.delay(.35, function()
        if token ~= NoirPersistence.token then return end
        NoirPersistence.WriteNow()
        NoirPersistence.dirty = false
    end)
end
function NoirPersistence.GetValue(bucket, key, fallback)
    local store = NoirPersistence.data[bucket]
    if type(store) ~= "table" then return fallback end
    local value = store[key]
    if value == nil then return fallback end
    return value
end
function NoirPersistence.SetValue(bucket, key, value, immediate)
    if type(NoirPersistence.data[bucket]) ~= "table" then NoirPersistence.data[bucket] = {} end
    NoirPersistence.data[bucket][key] = value
    NoirPersistence.Save(immediate)
end
function NoirPersistence.GetPosition(key, fallback)
    local p = NoirPersistence.data.positions[key]
    if typeof(p) == "table" and #p == 4 then return UDim2.new(p[1], p[2], p[3], p[4]) end
    return fallback
end
function NoirPersistence.SetPosition(key, p)
    NoirPersistence.data.positions[key] = { p.X.Scale, p.X.Offset, p.Y.Scale, p.Y.Offset }
    NoirPersistence.Save()
end

    base = Color3.fromRGB(3,10,15), surface = Color3.fromRGB(7,21,29), panel = Color3.fromRGB(6,18,25),
    card = Color3.fromRGB(9,28,36), border = Color3.fromRGB(24,104,112), accent = Color3.fromRGB(38,240,228),
    accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(160,255,250), text = Color3.fromRGB(220,248,246), dim = Color3.fromRGB(104,156,162),
    off = Color3.fromRGB(13,34,42), btn = Color3.fromRGB(8,30,38),
}
local gui
function New(class, props)
    props = props or {}
    local x = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do if k ~= "Parent" then x[k] = v end end
    local isTextObject = false
    pcall(function() isTextObject = x:IsA("TextLabel") or x:IsA("TextButton") or x:IsA("TextBox") end)
    if isTextObject then
        pcall(function() x.TextScaled = false end)
        pcall(function() x.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd end)
        if props.Font == nil then pcall(function() x.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium end) end
    end
    local langState = NoirGenv().__NoirLangState
    if type(langState) == "table" then
        langState.renderedToSource = langState.renderedToSource or {}
        local function rememberText(property, sourceAttribute, renderedAttribute)
            local ok, value = pcall(function() return x[property] end)
            if not ok or type(value) ~= "string" then return end
            local source = langState.renderedToSource[value] or value
            pcall(function()
                x:SetAttribute(sourceAttribute, source)
                x:SetAttribute(renderedAttribute, value)
            end)
        end
        local isTextLabel = false
        local isTextButton = false
        local isTextBox = false
        pcall(function()
            isTextLabel = x:IsA("TextLabel")
            isTextButton = x:IsA("TextButton")
            isTextBox = x:IsA("TextBox")
        end)
        if isTextBox then
            local ok, value = pcall(function() return x.PlaceholderText end)
            if ok and type(value) == "string" then
                local source = langState.renderedToSource[value] or value
                pcall(function() x.PlaceholderText = NoirTr(source) end)
            end
            rememberText("PlaceholderText", "__NoirPlaceholderSource", "__NoirPlaceholderRendered")
        elseif isTextLabel or isTextButton then
            local ok, value = pcall(function() return x.Text end)
            if ok and type(value) == "string" then
                local source = langState.renderedToSource[value] or value
                pcall(function() x.Text = NoirTr(source) end)
            end
            rememberText("Text", "__NoirTextSource", "__NoirTextRendered")
        end
        if isTextLabel or isTextButton or isTextBox then
            langState.originalTextDirections = langState.originalTextDirections or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
            langState.originalTextXAlignments = langState.originalTextXAlignments or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
            local alignmentOk, originalAlignment = pcall(function() return x.TextXAlignment end)
            if alignmentOk and langState.originalTextXAlignments[x] == nil then
                langState.originalTextXAlignments[x] = originalAlignment
            end
            if alignmentOk and langState.lang == "ar" and originalAlignment == Enum.TextXAlignment.Left then
                pcall(function() x.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right end)
            end
            local directionOk, originalDirection = pcall(function() return x.TextDirection end)
            if directionOk and langState.originalTextDirections[x] == nil then
                langState.originalTextDirections[x] = originalDirection
            end
            if langState.lang == "ar" then
                local txt2 = ""
                pcall(function() txt2 = x.Text or "" end)
                local hasArabic2 = txt2:match("[\216-\219][\128-\191]") ~= nil
                local hasLatin2 = txt2:match("[A-Za-z]") ~= nil
                if hasLatin2 and not hasArabic2 then
                    pcall(function() x.TextDirection = Enum.TextDirection.LeftToRight end)
                else
                    pcall(function() x.TextDirection = Enum.TextDirection.RightToLeft end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    x.Parent = props and props.Parent
    return x
end
local function refreshNoirLanguage()
    local state = NoirGenv().__NoirLangState
    if type(state) ~= "table" then return false end
    state.renderedToSource = state.renderedToSource or {}
    state.originalTextDirections = state.originalTextDirections or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    state.originalTextXAlignments = state.originalTextXAlignments or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local roots, seenRoots = {}, {}
    local function addRoot(root)
        if typeof(root) == "Instance" and not seenRoots[root] then
            seenRoots[root] = true
            roots[#roots + 1] = root
        end
    end
    addRoot(gui)
    if type(gethui) == "function" then local ok, root = pcall(gethui); if ok then addRoot(root) end end
    if type(getcore) == "function" then local ok, root = pcall(getcore); if ok then addRoot(root) end end
    addRoot(CoreGui)
    local playerGuiOk, playerGui = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") end)
    if playerGuiOk then addRoot(playerGui) end

    local namedScreens = {
        ["@fling"] = true, ["@odh_bjp_bigstorage"] = true, ["@odh_bjp_bindstorage"] = true,
        ["@wallhopstorage"] = true, ["@bindstorage_v6"] = true, ["@bindstorage_v5"] = true,
        ["@flingstorage_v1"] = true, ["MM2ShootMurderButton"] = true
    }
    local function belongsToNoirScreen(instance)
        local cursor = instance
        while cursor do
            local ok, isScreenGui, name = pcall(function() return cursor:IsA("ScreenGui"), cursor.Name end)
            if ok and isScreenGui then
                return name == "NoirSilentAimUI" or name:sub(1, 4) == "Noir" or namedScreens[name] == true
            end
            local parentOk, parent = pcall(function() return cursor.Parent end)
            if not parentOk then break end
            cursor = parent
        end
        return false
    end
    local function hasNoirLanguageMarker(instance)
        local ok, source, placeholder = pcall(function()
            return instance:GetAttribute("__NoirTextSource"), instance:GetAttribute("__NoirPlaceholderSource")
        end)
        return ok and (type(source) == "string" or type(placeholder) == "string")
    end
    local function refreshProperty(instance, property, sourceAttribute, renderedAttribute)
        local readOk, current = pcall(function() return instance[property] end)
        if not readOk or type(current) ~= "string" or current == "" then return end
        local source, lastRendered
        pcall(function()
            source = instance:GetAttribute(sourceAttribute)
            lastRendered = instance:GetAttribute(renderedAttribute)
        end)
        if type(source) ~= "string" or current ~= lastRendered then
            source = state.renderedToSource[current] or current
        end
        local translated = NoirTr(source)
        pcall(function() instance[property] = translated end)
        pcall(function()
            instance:SetAttribute(sourceAttribute, source)
            instance:SetAttribute(renderedAttribute, translated)
        end)
    end
    local function applyDirection(instance)
        local alignmentOk, currentAlignment = pcall(function() return instance.TextXAlignment end)
        if alignmentOk then
            if state.originalTextXAlignments[instance] == nil then state.originalTextXAlignments[instance] = currentAlignment end
            local originalAlignment = state.originalTextXAlignments[instance]
            if state.lang == "ar" and originalAlignment == Enum.TextXAlignment.Left then
                pcall(function() instance.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right end)
            elseif originalAlignment ~= nil then
                pcall(function() instance.TextXAlignment = originalAlignment end)
            end
        end
        local ok, current = pcall(function() return instance.TextDirection end)
        if not ok then return end
        if state.originalTextDirections[instance] == nil then state.originalTextDirections[instance] = current end
        if state.lang == "ar" then
            local txt = ""
            pcall(function() txt = instance.Text or "" end)
            local hasArabic = txt:match("[\216-\219][\128-\191]") ~= nil
            local hasLatin = txt:match("[A-Za-z]") ~= nil
            if hasLatin and not hasArabic then
                pcall(function() instance.TextDirection = Enum.TextDirection.LeftToRight end)
            else
                pcall(function() instance.TextDirection = Enum.TextDirection.RightToLeft end)
            end
        else
            local original = state.originalTextDirections[instance]
            if original ~= nil then pcall(function() instance.TextDirection = original end) end
        end
    end

    local seenInstances = {}
    for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
        local objects = { root }
        local ok, descendants = pcall(function() return root:GetDescendants() end)
        if ok then for _, child in ipairs(descendants) do objects[#objects + 1] = child end end
        for _, instance in ipairs(objects) do
            if not seenInstances[instance] and (belongsToNoirScreen(instance) or hasNoirLanguageMarker(instance)) then
                seenInstances[instance] = true
                local ok, isTextLabel, isTextButton, isTextBox = pcall(function()
                    return instance:IsA("TextLabel"), instance:IsA("TextButton"), instance:IsA("TextBox")
                end)
                if ok then
                    if isTextBox then
                        refreshProperty(instance, "PlaceholderText", "__NoirPlaceholderSource", "__NoirPlaceholderRendered")
                    elseif isTextLabel or isTextButton then
                        refreshProperty(instance, "Text", "__NoirTextSource", "__NoirTextRendered")
                    end
                    if isTextLabel or isTextButton or isTextBox then applyDirection(instance) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end
NoirGenv().__NoirRefreshLanguage = refreshNoirLanguage

function corner(x, r)
    if not x then return nil end
    local c = x:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
    if not c then c = New("UICorner", { Name = "NoirCorner", Parent = x }) end
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.max(0, tonumber(r) or 12))
    return c
end
local gradientStrokes = { fast = {} }
function ringStroke(x, thickness, transparency)
    local ring = New("UIStroke", {
        Parent = x,
        Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 248),
        Thickness = thickness or 1.6,
        Transparency = transparency or .18,
        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
    })
    New("UIGradient", { Parent = ring, Rotation = 25, Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(56, 121, 120)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.22, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 248)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.48, Color3.fromRGB(72, 154, 152)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.72, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 248)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(53, 116, 115)),
    }) })
    return ring
end

function stroke(x, col, tr, thickness)
    -- ВАЖНО: не передаём ApplyStrokeMode в таблицу свойств.
    -- Новые билды Roblox кидают "Position is not a valid member of UIStroke",
    -- когда UIStroke создаётся с таблицей свойств и BorderMode.
    local s = New("UIStroke", { Color = col or C.border, Transparency = tr or .55, Thickness = thickness or 1, Parent = x })
    pcall(function() s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border end)
    return s
end
local gradientAccum = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    local fast = gradientStrokes.fast
    if #fast == 0 then return end
    gradientAccum += dt
    -- OPTIM: шаг 0.15с вместо 0.12с + пропуск невидимых кнопок (меньше перерисовок GPU)
    if gradientAccum < 0.15 then return end
    local step = gradientAccum * 30
    gradientAccum = 0
    for i = #fast, 1, -1 do
        local g = fast[i]
        if g.Parent then
            local host = g.Parent.Parent
            if host and host.Visible ~= false then
                g.Rotation = (g.Rotation + step) % 360
            end
        else
            table.remove(fast, i)
        end
    end
end)
function kitiTitle(parent, value)
    local accent = New("Frame", { Parent = parent, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 8), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 14),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
    corner(accent, 1.5)
    New("UIStroke", { Parent = accent, Color = C.accent, Thickness = 3, Transparency = .6, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
    local l = text(parent, value, 14, UDim2.fromOffset(20, 6))
    l.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    l.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 15)
    l.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    l.TextColor3 = C.text
    l.TextTransparency = 0
    return l
end
function kitiDesc(parent, value)
    local l = text(parent, value, 11, UDim2.fromOffset(20, 27), true)
    l.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 14)
    l.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    return l
end
function text(parent, value, size, pos, dim)
    return New("TextLabel", { Parent = parent, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = NoirTr(value), TextColor3 = dim and C.dim or C.text,
        TextSize = size, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextWrapped = false,
        TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), TextStrokeTransparency = .82,
        Position = pos or UDim2.new(), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, size + 8) })
end

function hudBrackets(parent, len, thick, color, transparency, zindex)
    local list = {}
    for _, c in ipairs({ { 0, 0 }, { 1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 1, 1 } }) do
        local ax, ay = c[1], c[2]
        local hOk, hFrame = pcall(New, "Frame", { Parent = parent, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = UDim2.fromScale(ax, ay), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len, thick),
            BackgroundColor3 = color, BackgroundTransparency = transparency or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = zindex or 10 })
        if hOk and hFrame then list[#list + 1] = hFrame end
        local vOk, vFrame = pcall(New, "Frame", { Parent = parent, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = UDim2.fromScale(ax, ay), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(thick, len),
            BackgroundColor3 = color, BackgroundTransparency = transparency or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = zindex or 10 })
        if vOk and vFrame then list[#list + 1] = vFrame end
    end
    return list
end

-- ===== NOIR CYBER HUD v7: universal neon restyler shared by ALL floating buttons =====
-- One design language for every on-screen button: dark solid body, rotating neon
-- ring, soft halo, inner tech ring, top sheen, HUD brackets / reticle ticks.
NoirCyberHUD = {
    BODY = Color3.fromRGB(6, 18, 25),
    TEXT = Color3.fromRGB(220, 248, 246),
    CYAN = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,    Color3.fromRGB(9, 62, 68)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.18, Color3.fromRGB(38, 240, 228)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.38, Color3.fromRGB(8, 26, 32)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.62, Color3.fromRGB(160, 255, 250)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.82, Color3.fromRGB(10, 78, 84)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,    Color3.fromRGB(9, 62, 68)),
    }),
    GOLD = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,    Color3.fromRGB(70, 44, 10)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.18, Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 64)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.38, Color3.fromRGB(26, 20, 8)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.62, Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 140)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.82, Color3.fromRGB(92, 60, 14)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,    Color3.fromRGB(70, 44, 10)),
    }),
    WAIT = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,   Color3.fromRGB(220, 248, 246)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(38, 240, 228)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,   Color3.fromRGB(220, 248, 246)),
    }),
    CYAN_DIM = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(24, 104, 112)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(12, 52, 58)),
    }),
    _items = {}, _conn = nil,
}
-- expose to satellite modules (movement / speed glitch / troll use NoirGenv().NoirCyberHUD)
pcall(function() NoirGenv().NoirCyberHUD = NoirCyberHUD end)
function NoirCyberHUD._register(button, gradient, orbit)
    -- CYBER HUD v8: вращаем обводку (gradient) и орбиту палочек (orbit) на КАЖДОЙ
    -- кнопке без исключений; один из аргументов может быть nil.
    if typeof(button) ~= "Instance" then return end
    local gradOk = gradient == nil or typeof(gradient) == "Instance"
    local orbitOk = orbit == nil or typeof(orbit) == "Instance"
    if not gradOk or not orbitOk or (gradient == nil and orbit == nil) then return end
    NoirCyberHUD._items[button] = { grad = gradient, orbit = orbit, rot = math.random(0, 359) }
    if NoirCyberHUD._conn then return end
    NoirCyberHUD._conn = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        local alive = false
        for btn, item in pairs(NoirCyberHUD._items) do
            if typeof(btn) == "Instance" and btn.Parent then
                alive = true
                item.rot = (item.rot + dt * 40) % 360
                if item.grad then pcall(function() item.grad.Rotation = item.rot end) end
                if item.orbit then pcall(function() item.orbit.Rotation = ((item.orbit.Rotation or 0) + dt * 55) % 360 end) end
            else
                NoirCyberHUD._items[btn] = nil
            end
        end
        if not alive and NoirCyberHUD._conn then
            NoirCyberHUD._conn:Disconnect()
            NoirCyberHUD._conn = nil
        end
    end)
end
function NoirCyberHUD.apply(button, cfg)
    cfg = cfg or {}
    if typeof(button) ~= "Instance" then return nil end
    local round = cfg.round ~= false
    local z = button.ZIndex or 5
    pcall(function()
        for _, inst in ipairs(button:GetChildren()) do
            if inst:IsA("UIStroke") then inst:Destroy() end
        end
        for _, nm in ipairs({ "NoirSheen", "NoirBracket", "NoirTickOrbit", "NoirTick", "NoirOrbitStroke" }) do
            local old = button:FindFirstChild(nm)
            if old then old:Destroy() end
        end
    end)
    button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    corner(button, round and 999 or (cfg.radius or 12))
    local ringColor = cfg.ring or (round and NoirCyberHUD.CYAN or NoirCyberHUD.CYAN)
    local outer = New("UIStroke", { Parent = button, Name = "NoirRing", Color = C.accent,
        Thickness = cfg.thickness or 2.4, Transparency = .06, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
    local ringGradient = New("UIGradient", { Parent = outer, Name = "NoirRingGradient", Rotation = 0, Color = ringColor })
    local halo = New("UIStroke", { Parent = button, Name = "NoirHalo", Color = C.accent,
        Thickness = 7, Transparency = .88, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
    local inner = New("UIStroke", { Parent = button, Name = "NoirOrbitStroke", Color = C.border,
        Thickness = 1, Transparency = .5, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
    local innerGradient = New("UIGradient", { Parent = inner, Rotation = 180, Color = NoirCyberHUD.CYAN_DIM })
    local sheen = New("Frame", { Parent = button, Name = "NoirSheen", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, .4, 0),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = .84, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z + 2 })
    New("UICorner", { Parent = sheen, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, round and 999 or (cfg.radius or 12)) })
    New("UIGradient", { Parent = sheen, Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, .3), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.65, .85), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }) })
    local brackets
    if not round and cfg.brackets ~= false then
        brackets = hudBrackets(button, cfg.bracketLen or 10, 1.6, C.accent2, .3, z + 3)
        for _, f in ipairs(brackets) do f.Name = "NoirBracket" end
    end
    local tickOrbit
    if round and cfg.tickMarks ~= false then
        -- CYBER HUD v8: палочки живут во вращающемся контейнере и летят по орбите
        tickOrbit = New("Frame", { Parent = button, Name = "NoirTickOrbit", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Rotation = 0, ZIndex = z + 3 })
        for _, c in ipairs({ { 1, 0, 45 }, { 0, 0, -45 }, { 1, 1, -45 }, { 0, 1, 45 } }) do
            New("Frame", { Parent = tickOrbit, Name = "NoirTick", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(c[1], c[2]),
                Position = UDim2.fromScale(c[1], c[2]), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 1.6),
                BackgroundColor3 = C.accent, BackgroundTransparency = .3, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Rotation = c[3], ZIndex = z + 3 })
        end
    end
    -- v8: вращение обводки включено на ВСЕХ кнопках — cfg.autoRotate больше не отключает его
    NoirCyberHUD._register(button, ringGradient, tickOrbit)
    return { outer = ringGradient, ring = outer, halo = halo, inner = inner, sheen = sheen, brackets = brackets, orbit = tickOrbit }
end

-- noirHudCorners: technical bracket corners (ported from the Blade Ball build;
-- was called by the dashboard but never defined -> loader FAILED)
function noirHudCorners(parent, length, color, transparency, zIndex)
    local z = zIndex or ((parent.ZIndex or 1) + 1)
    for _, point in ipairs({ {0,0}, {1,0}, {0,1}, {1,1} }) do
        local ax, ay = point[1], point[2]
        local h = Instance.new("Frame")
        h.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay); h.Position = UDim2.fromScale(ax, ay)
        h.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(length, 1.4); h.BackgroundColor3 = color
        h.BackgroundTransparency = transparency or 0; h.BorderSizePixel = 0; h.ZIndex = z; h.Parent = parent
        local v = Instance.new("Frame")
        v.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay); v.Position = UDim2.fromScale(ax, ay)
        v.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1.4, length); v.BackgroundColor3 = color
        v.BackgroundTransparency = transparency or 0; v.BorderSizePixel = 0; v.ZIndex = z; v.Parent = parent
    end
end


gui = New("ScreenGui", { Name = "NoirSilentAimUI", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, Parent = guiParent })
__NOIR_GUARD.gui = gui
NoirFX.gui = gui

-- Stream Mode keeps every panel visible and only hides button visuals.
-- Buttons remain visible/active/clickable; their original styling is restored on exit.
local streamModeButton = nil
local function createStreamModeController()
local STREAM_MODE_GLOBAL = "__NoirStreamModeController"
local streamEnvironment = NoirGenv()
local previousStreamMode = rawget(streamEnvironment, STREAM_MODE_GLOBAL)
if type(previousStreamMode) == "table" and type(previousStreamMode.Destroy) == "function" then
    pcall(previousStreamMode.Destroy, previousStreamMode)
end

local StreamMode = {
    active = false,
    saved = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    watched = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    roots = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    markedRoots = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    rootConnections = {},
    propertyConnections = {},
    inputConnections = {},
    playerGuiConnection = nil,
}
local STREAM_MODE_MAIN_GUI = "NoirSilentAimUI"
local STREAM_MODE_NAMED_SCREENS = {
    ["@fling"] = true,
    ["@odh_bjp_bigstorage"] = true,
    ["@odh_bjp_bindstorage"] = true,
    ["@wallhopstorage"] = true,
    ["@bindstorage_v6"] = true,
    ["@bindstorage_v5"] = true,
    ["@flingstorage_v1"] = true,
    ["MM2ShootMurdererButton"] = true,

}
local STREAM_MODE_MARKER_PREFIX = "@fling_"

local function streamSetVisual(self, instance, property, hiddenValue)
    local properties = self.saved[instance]
    if not properties then
        properties = {}
        self.saved[instance] = properties
    end
    local state = properties[property]
    if not state then
        local ok, original = pcall(function() return instance[property] end)
        if not ok then return false end
        state = { original = original, hidden = hiddenValue }
        properties[property] = state
    else
        state.hidden = hiddenValue
    end
    local watched = self.watched[instance]
    if not watched then
        watched = {}
        self.watched[instance] = watched
    end
    if not watched[property] then
        watched[property] = true
        local ok, connection = pcall(function()
            return instance:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(function()
                if not self.active then return end
                local savedProperties = self.saved[instance]
                local currentState = savedProperties and savedProperties[property]
                if not currentState then return end
                local readOk, current = pcall(function() return instance[property] end)
                if readOk and current ~= currentState.hidden then
                    -- Keep the original snapshot stable: hover/press animations
                    -- must not become the appearance restored when Stream Mode ends.
                    pcall(function() instance[property] = currentState.hidden end)
                end
            end)
        end)
        if ok and connection then table.insert(self.propertyConnections, connection) end
    end
    pcall(function() instance[property] = hiddenValue end)
    return true
end
local function streamHideVisual(self, instance)
    local ok, className, isGuiObject = pcall(function()
        return instance.ClassName, instance:IsA("GuiObject")
    end)
    if not ok then return false end
    local changed = false
    if isGuiObject then
        changed = streamSetVisual(self, instance, "BackgroundTransparency", 1) or changed
    end
    if className == "TextButton" or className == "TextLabel" or className == "TextBox" then
        changed = streamSetVisual(self, instance, "TextTransparency", 1) or changed
        changed = streamSetVisual(self, instance, "TextStrokeTransparency", 1) or changed
    end
    if className == "ImageButton" or className == "ImageLabel" or className == "ViewportFrame" then
        changed = streamSetVisual(self, instance, "ImageTransparency", 1) or changed
    end
    if className == "ScrollingFrame" then
        changed = streamSetVisual(self, instance, "ScrollBarImageTransparency", 1) or changed
    end
    if className == "UIStroke" then
        changed = streamSetVisual(self, instance, "Transparency", 1) or changed
    end
    return changed
end

local function streamIsButtonDecoration(instance)
    local ok, className = pcall(function() return instance.ClassName end)
    return ok and (className == "TextLabel" or className == "ImageLabel" or className == "ViewportFrame" or className == "UIStroke")
end

local function streamHideButtonVisuals(self, button)
    local changed = streamHideVisual(self, button)
    -- Only touch direct label/icon/stroke children. Do not recurse into Frames or
    -- nested content: some GUI panels use a GuiButton as a container.
    local ok, children = pcall(function() return button:GetChildren() end)
    if ok then
        for _, child in ipairs(children) do
            if streamIsButtonDecoration(child) then
                changed = streamHideVisual(self, child) or changed
            end
        end
    end
    return changed
end

local function streamFindMarkedRoot(self, instance)
    local cursor = instance
    while cursor do
        if self.markedRoots[cursor] then return cursor end
        local ok, parent = pcall(function() return cursor.Parent end)
        if not ok then break end
        cursor = parent
    end
    return nil
end

local function streamIsManagedGui(self, instance)
    if streamFindMarkedRoot(self, instance) then return true end
    local cursor = instance
    while cursor do
        local ok, isScreenGui, name = pcall(function()
            return cursor:IsA("ScreenGui"), cursor.Name
        end)
        if ok and isScreenGui then
            -- Keep the main Noir Hub panel and every control inside it untouched.
            if name == STREAM_MODE_MAIN_GUI then return false end
            return name:sub(1, 4) == "Noir" or STREAM_MODE_NAMED_SCREENS[name] == true
        end
        local parentOk, parent = pcall(function() return cursor.Parent end)
        if not parentOk then break end
        cursor = parent
    end
    return false
end
function StreamMode:IsActive()
    return self.active == true
end

function StreamMode:ApplyInstance(instance)
    if not self.active or typeof(instance) ~= "Instance" then return false end
    local ok, name, className, isButton = pcall(function()
        return instance.Name, instance.ClassName, instance:IsA("GuiButton")
    end)
    if not ok then return false end

    if className == "StringValue" and name:sub(1, #STREAM_MODE_MARKER_PREFIX) == STREAM_MODE_MARKER_PREFIX then
        local parentOk, parent = pcall(function() return instance.Parent end)
        if parentOk and parent then
            local guiOk, parentIsGuiObject = pcall(function() return parent:IsA("GuiObject") end)
            if guiOk and parentIsGuiObject then
                self.markedRoots[parent] = true
                return streamHideButtonVisuals(self, parent)
            end
        end
    end

    -- The minimize/restore handle is navigation, not stream content. Never hide it:
    -- hiding its visual made a minimized hub impossible to reopen while Stream Mode was active.
    if className == "TextButton" and name == "NoirRestoreButton" then
        return false
    end
    if not streamIsManagedGui(self, instance) then return false end
    if isButton then
        return streamHideButtonVisuals(self, instance)
    end

    local parentOk, parent = pcall(function() return instance.Parent end)
    if parentOk and parent and streamIsButtonDecoration(instance) then
        local parentButtonOk, parentIsButton = pcall(function() return parent:IsA("GuiButton") end)
        if parentButtonOk and parentIsButton then
            return streamHideVisual(self, instance)
        end
    end

    local markedRoot = streamFindMarkedRoot(self, instance)
    if markedRoot and parentOk and parent == markedRoot and streamIsButtonDecoration(instance) then
        return streamHideVisual(self, instance)
    end
    -- ScreenGuis, panels, Frames, and nested non-button UI stay untouched.
    return false
end
function StreamMode:ApplyGui(instance)
    return self:ApplyInstance(instance)
end

function StreamMode:AttachRoot(root)
    if not self.active or typeof(root) ~= "Instance" or self.roots[root] then return end
    self.roots[root] = true
    local ok, connection = pcall(function()
        return root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
            local function applyNewControl()
                if self.active then self:ApplyInstance(descendant) end
            end
            local deferred = false
            if type(task) == "table" and type(task.defer) == "function" then
                deferred = pcall(function() task.defer(applyNewControl) end)
            end
            if not deferred then applyNewControl() end
        end)
    end)
    if ok and connection then table.insert(self.rootConnections, connection) end
    self:ApplyInstance(root)
    local descendantsOk, descendants = pcall(function() return root:GetDescendants() end)
    if descendantsOk then
        for _, descendant in ipairs(descendants) do self:ApplyInstance(descendant) end
    end
end

function StreamMode:AttachRoots()
    if not self.active then return end
    local roots, seen = {}, {}
    local function add(root)
        if typeof(root) == "Instance" and not seen[root] then
            seen[root] = true
            roots[#roots + 1] = root
        end
    end
    if type(gethui) == "function" then local ok, root = pcall(gethui); if ok then add(root) end end
    if type(getcore) == "function" then local ok, root = pcall(getcore); if ok then add(root) end end
    add(CoreGui)
    local playerGuiOk, playerGui = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") end)
    if playerGuiOk then add(playerGui) end
    for _, root in ipairs(roots) do self:AttachRoot(root) end
    if not self.playerGuiConnection then
        local ok, connection = pcall(function()
            return LocalPlayer.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                local childOk, isPlayerGui = pcall(function() return child:IsA("PlayerGui") end)
                if self.active and childOk and isPlayerGui then self:AttachRoot(child) end
            end)
        end)
        if ok then self.playerGuiConnection = connection end
    end
end

function StreamMode:DisconnectRoots()
    for _, connection in ipairs(self.rootConnections) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(self.rootConnections)
    if self.playerGuiConnection then pcall(function() self.playerGuiConnection:Disconnect() end) end
    self.playerGuiConnection = nil
    table.clear(self.roots)
end

function StreamMode:DisconnectPropertyWatchers()
    for _, connection in ipairs(self.propertyConnections) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(self.propertyConnections)
end

function StreamMode:SetActive(value, silent)
    value = value == true
    if value == self.active then
        if value then self:AttachRoots() end
        return false
    end
    self.active = value
    if value then
        self:AttachRoots()
    else
        self:DisconnectRoots()
        self:DisconnectPropertyWatchers()
        for instance, properties in pairs(self.saved) do
            for property, state in pairs(properties) do
                pcall(function() instance[property] = state.original end)
            end
        end
        table.clear(self.saved)
        table.clear(self.watched)
        table.clear(self.markedRoots)
    end
    if not silent and type(self.onChanged) == "function" then pcall(self.onChanged, value) end
    return true
end

function StreamMode:Toggle()
    return self:SetActive(not self.active)
end

function StreamMode:Destroy()
    self:SetActive(false, true)
    for _, connection in ipairs(self.inputConnections) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(self.inputConnections)
    self.onChanged = nil
end

local function updateStreamModeButton()
    if typeof(streamModeButton) == "Instance" and streamModeButton.Parent then
        streamModeButton.Text = NoirTr(StreamMode.active and "Stream Mode: ON" or "Stream Mode: OFF")
    end
    pcall(function()
        if type(NoirGenv().__NoirStreamLabelUpdate) == "function" then
            NoirGenv().__NoirStreamLabelUpdate(StreamMode.active == true)
        end
    end)
end
StreamMode.onChanged = function(enabled)
    NoirPersistence.data.toggles["Noir::StreamMode"] = enabled
    NoirPersistence.Save()
    updateStreamModeButton()
end
rawset(streamEnvironment, STREAM_MODE_GLOBAL, StreamMode)

local activeStreamTouches = {}
local streamTouchHolding, streamTouchFired, streamTouchToken = false, false, nil
local function streamTouchCount()
    local count = 0
    for _ in pairs(activeStreamTouches) do count = count + 1 end
    return count
end
local inputBeganOk, streamInputBegan = pcall(function()
    return UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
            local textFocused = false
            pcall(function() textFocused = UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= nil end)
            if not textFocused then StreamMode:Toggle() end
            return
        end
        -- v34 fix: случайные переключения Stream Mode в бою (3 пальца на телефоне
        -- при игре с пушкой) — тач-жест полностью убран. Переключение: RightShift
        -- на клавиатуре или кнопка "Stream Mode" в настройках.
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            return
        end
    end)
end)
if inputBeganOk and streamInputBegan then table.insert(StreamMode.inputConnections, streamInputBegan) end
local inputEndedOk, streamInputEnded = pcall(function()
    return UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        activeStreamTouches[input] = nil
        if streamTouchCount() < 3 then
            streamTouchHolding, streamTouchFired, streamTouchToken = false, false, nil
        end
    end)
end)
if inputEndedOk and streamInputEnded then table.insert(StreamMode.inputConnections, streamInputEnded) end

StreamMode:SetActive(NoirPersistence.data.toggles["Noir::StreamMode"] == true, true)
return StreamMode, updateStreamModeButton
end
local StreamMode, updateStreamModeButton = createStreamModeController()

function rescale()
    local v = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
    local usable = math.max(v.Y - 70, 320)
    scale.Scale = math.min(v.X / 1080, usable / 720, 0.96)
end
rescale()
if workspace.CurrentCamera then workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(rescale) end
function styleCircularButton(b, diameter)
    -- CYBER HUD v8: круглая кнопка в едином Grab Gun стиле — тёмный корпус,
    -- неоновое кольцо с градиентом, гало, орбита палочек, вращение обводки.
    -- Ховер остался (светлеет), звук и нажатие даёт общий noirNovaButton.
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(6, 18, 25)
    b.BackgroundTransparency = .16
    b.BorderSizePixel = 0
    b.AutoButtonColor = false
    b.ClipsDescendants = false
    b.ZIndex = 20
    corner(b, 999)
    pcall(function() noirNovaButton(b, { round = true }) end)
    b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(.15), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 36, 44) }):Play()
    end)
    b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(.2), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(6, 18, 25) }):Play()
    end)
    return b
end
function topButton(txt, x, color, fontSize)
    local b = New("TextButton", { Parent = header, Position = UDim2.new(1, x, 0, 26), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44),
        BackgroundColor3 = color or C.btn, Text = txt, TextColor3 = C.text, TextSize = fontSize or 22, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold })
    return styleCircularButton(b, 44)
end

-- ===== NOVA CRYSTAL: единый премиум-конструктор плавающих кнопок =====
-- Один вызов превращает плоскую кнопку в полный NovaUI-дизайн: стеклянный
-- корпус с градиентом, световая грань, вращающийся металлический двойной
-- контур, HUD-уголки, ripple-волна и пружинное нажатие.
local novaPressInfo = TweenInfo.new(.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local novaReleaseInfo = TweenInfo.new(.30, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local novaMetal = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(10, 46, 56)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.22, Color3.fromRGB(56, 210, 240)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.48, Color3.fromRGB(18, 90, 106)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.72, Color3.fromRGB(150, 244, 252)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(8, 38, 46)),
})
-- ===== NOIR CYBER HUD v6: 9-slice фреймы кнопок (срезанные углы, неоновая кромка) =====
-- Запечены оффлайн в стиле фото-референса; грузятся через writefile + getcustomasset,
-- при их отсутствии используется векторный фолбэк (кольцо + гало + HUD-уголки).
local novaSliceCenter = Rect.new(32, 32, 224, 72)
local novaFrameIdleB64 = __noirAsset("novaFrameIdleB64.png")
local novaFrameActiveB64 = __noirAsset("novaFrameActiveB64.png")
local novaFrameIdle, novaFrameActive = "", ""
local novaRoundIdle, novaRoundActive = "", ""
local novaRoundIdleB64 = __noirAsset("novaRoundIdleB64.png")
local novaRoundActiveB64 = __noirAsset("novaRoundActiveB64.png")
do
    local customAsset = (type(getcustomasset) == "function" and getcustomasset) or (type(getsynasset) == "function" and getsynasset)
    if type(writefile) == "function" and customAsset then
        if type(makefolder) == "function" then pcall(makefolder, ASSETS_FOLDER) end
        local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
        local function decode64(data)
            return (data:gsub("[^" .. alphabet .. "=]", ""):gsub(".", function(x)
                if x == "=" then return "" end
                local r, f = "", alphabet:find(x, 1, true) - 1
                for i = 6, 1, -1 do r = r .. (f % 2 ^ i - f % 2 ^ (i - 1) > 0 and "1" or "0") end
                return r
            end):gsub("%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?", function(x)
                if #x ~= 8 then return "" end
                local c = 0
                for i = 1, 8 do c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == "1" and 2 ^ (8 - i) or 0) end
                return string.char(c)
            end))
        end
        local function loadFrame(data, name)
            local ok, asset = pcall(function()
                local path = ASSETS_FOLDER .. "/" .. name
                writefile(path, decode64(data))
                return customAsset(path)
            end)
            if ok and type(asset) == "string" then return asset end
            return ""
        end
        novaFrameIdle = loadFrame(novaFrameIdleB64, "NOIR_HUD_FRAME_IDLE.png")
        novaFrameActive = loadFrame(novaFrameActiveB64, "NOIR_HUD_FRAME_ACTIVE.png")
        novaRoundIdle = loadFrame(novaRoundIdleB64, "NOIR_HUD_ROUND_IDLE.png")
        novaRoundActive = loadFrame(novaRoundActiveB64, "NOIR_HUD_ROUND_ACTIVE.png")
    end
end

local function noirNovaButtonImpl(b, cfg)
    -- NOIR CYBER HUD v6: дизайн с фото-референса — чёрный корпус, неоновый cyan-контур
    -- с мягким гало, срезанные углы (9-slice) и верхний блик. Круглые кнопки
    -- (cfg.round) рисуются векторным кольцом, прямоугольные получают 9-slice корпус
    -- (если экзекутор поддерживает getcustomasset), иначе векторный фолбэк.
    -- API сохранён: колбэки пишут novaFx.outer.Color = ColorSequence (прокси состояния).
    cfg = cfg or {}
    local z = b.ZIndex or 5
    b.BorderSizePixel = 0
    b.AutoButtonColor = false
    local useRound = cfg.round == true
    corner(b, useRound and 999 or (cfg.radius or 12))
    local outer = New("UIStroke", { Parent = b, Color = C.accent, Thickness = cfg.thickness or 2, Transparency = .08, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
    local outerGradient = New("UIGradient", { Parent = outer, Rotation = 35, Color = cfg.gradient or novaMetal })
    local halo = New("UIStroke", { Parent = b, Color = C.accent, Thickness = 6, Transparency = .87, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
    New("UIStroke", { Parent = b, Color = C.border, Thickness = 1, Transparency = .55, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
    local sheen = New("Frame", { Parent = b, Name = "NoirSheen", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, .42, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = .82, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4 })
    New("UICorner", { Parent = sheen, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, useRound and 999 or (cfg.radius or 12)) })
    New("UIGradient", { Parent = sheen, Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, .4), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.6, .8), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }) })
    -- CYBER HUD v8: круглая форма — ретикл-тики на вращающейся орбите
    local tickOrbit
    if useRound then
        tickOrbit = New("Frame", { Parent = b, Name = "NoirTickOrbit", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Rotation = 0, ZIndex = z + 3 })
        for _, c in ipairs({ { 1, 0, 45 }, { 0, 0, -45 }, { 1, 1, -45 }, { 0, 1, 45 } }) do
            New("Frame", { Parent = tickOrbit, Name = "NoirTick", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(c[1], c[2]),
                Position = UDim2.fromScale(c[1], c[2]), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 1.6),
                BackgroundColor3 = C.accent, BackgroundTransparency = .3, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Rotation = c[3], ZIndex = z + 3 })
        end
        local orbit = New("UIStroke", { Parent = b, Name = "NoirOrbitStroke", Color = C.border, Thickness = 1,
            Transparency = .35, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
        New("UIGradient", { Parent = orbit, Rotation = 180, Color = novaMetal })
    end
    local brackets
    if cfg.brackets and not useRound then pcall(function() brackets = hudBrackets(b, cfg.bracketLen or 8, 1.4, C.accent2, .3, z + 2) end) end
    -- 9-slice корпус: срезанные углы как на референсе
    local bodyImage, roundBody = false, false
    if novaFrameIdle ~= "" and not useRound and b:IsA("ImageButton") then
        bodyImage = true
        b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        b.Image = novaFrameIdle
        b.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
        b.SliceCenter = novaSliceCenter
        pcall(function() b.SliceScale = 1 end)
        outer.Transparency = 1
        halo.Transparency = 1
        if brackets then for _, f in ipairs(brackets) do f.Visible = false end end
    elseif useRound and novaRoundIdle ~= "" and b:IsA("ImageButton") then
        roundBody = true
        b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        b.Image = novaRoundIdle
        b.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
        outer.Transparency = 1
        halo.Transparency = 1
        for _, nm in ipairs({ "NoirOrbitStroke" }) do
            local stale = b:FindFirstChild(nm)
            if stale then
                -- UIStroke/UIGradient are UIComponent: no .Visible member (crashed the whole build)
                if stale:IsA("GuiObject") then stale.Visible = false else stale.Enabled = false end
            end
        end
    end
    local function seqLum(seq)
        local r, g, bl, n = 0, 0, 0, 0
        for _, kp in ipairs(seq.Keypoints) do r += kp.Value.R; g += kp.Value.G; bl += kp.Value.B; n += 1 end
        if n == 0 then return 0 end
        return (r + g + bl) / (3 * n)
    end
    -- прокси состояния: прежние колбэки пишут bindOuterGradient.Color = seq
    local stateProxy = setmetatable({}, {
        __newindex = function(_, key, value)
            if key ~= "Color" or typeof(value) ~= "ColorSequence" then return end
            task.spawn(function()
                local bright = seqLum(value) > .45
                if bodyImage then
                    pcall(function() b.Image = bright and novaFrameActive or novaFrameIdle end)
                    return
                end
                if roundBody then
                    pcall(function() b.Image = bright and novaRoundActive or novaRoundIdle end)
                    return
                end
                pcall(function() outerGradient.Color = value end)
                pcall(function()
                    TweenService:Create(halo, TweenInfo.new(.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Transparency = bright and .72 or .87, Thickness = bright and 9 or 6 }):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(outer, TweenInfo.new(.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Transparency = bright and 0 or .14 }):Play()
                end)
            end)
        end,
    })
    pcall(function()
        if NoirCyberHUD and NoirCyberHUD._register then NoirCyberHUD._register(b, outerGradient, tickOrbit) end
    end)
    local pressScale = New("UIScale", { Parent = b, Scale = 1 })
    local function ripple()
        local r = New("Frame", { Parent = b, Name = "NovaRipple", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(.35, .35), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = z + 1 })
        corner(r, 999)
        local ring = New("UIStroke", { Parent = r, Color = C.accent2, Thickness = 2, Transparency = .2, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
        local grow = TweenService:Create(r, TweenInfo.new(.42, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) })
        local fade = TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(.42, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Transparency = 1 })
        grow:Play(); fade:Play()
        grow.Completed:Connect(function() r:Destroy() end)
    end
    local sound
    if cfg.sound ~= false then
        sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.Name = "NoirButtonSound"; sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://3868133279"; sound.Volume = .3; sound.Parent = b
    end
    if cfg.press ~= false then
        b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                if sound then sound:Play() end
                ripple()
                TweenService:Create(pressScale, novaPressInfo, { Scale = cfg.pressScale or 1.06 }):Play()
            end
        end)
        b.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                TweenService:Create(pressScale, novaReleaseInfo, { Scale = 1 }):Play()
            end
        end)
    end
    return { outer = stateProxy, inner = nil, scale = pressScale, ripple = ripple, sound = sound, ring = outer, halo = halo }
end

-- SAFETY NET v7.1: одна сломанная кнопка больше НЕ убивает сборку всего модуля.
-- Любая ошибка стилизации изолируется pcall и возвращает безопасный заглушечный fx.
function noirNovaButton(b, cfg)
    local ok, fx = pcall(noirNovaButtonImpl, b, cfg)
    if ok and type(fx) == "table" then return fx end
    pcall(function()
        warn("[Noir] button decoration failed safely: " .. tostring(fx))
        if typeof(b) == "Instance" then
            b.BorderSizePixel = 0
            b.AutoButtonColor = false
        end
    end)
    local fallbackProxy = setmetatable({}, { __newindex = function() end })
    return { outer = fallbackProxy, inner = nil, scale = nil, ripple = function() end, sound = nil, ring = nil, halo = nil }
end

 
local function __noirW1b()
local __R1 = {}
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  NOIR UI — embedded menu library (Noir_Menu.lua) + MM2 section adapter.
--  The whole NovaUI window is replaced by the user's Noir library: the hub
--  section API (tab:AddSection / section:AddToggle|Slider|Dropdown|Button|
--  Label|Paragraph|TextBox|Colorpicker|Keybind|PlayerDropdown) is mapped 1:1
--  onto Noir groupboxes. Every control keeps its NoirPersistence storage key
--  AND registers a Noir Flag, so configs save through the Noir config manager.
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function LoadNoir()

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local StatsService = game:GetService("Stats")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local Library = {}

Library.Flags = {}
Library.Windows = {}

local function normalize(source, map)
    local opts = {}
    if type(source) == "string" then
        opts.Name = source
    elseif type(source) == "table" then
        for key, value in pairs(source) do
            opts[key] = value
        end
    end
    for from, to in pairs(map or {}) do
        if opts[to] == nil and opts[from] ~= nil then
            opts[to] = opts[from]
        end
    end
    if opts.Range then
        opts.Min = opts.Min or opts.Range[1]
        opts.Max = opts.Max or opts.Range[2]
    end
    return opts
end

local function finishElement(tab, opts, element, frame, kind)
    element._type = kind
    element._frame = frame
    element._listeners = element._listeners or {}
    local window = tab and tab.Window
    local searchText = opts.Name or opts.Text or opts.Title
    element._searchName = type(searchText) == "string" and searchText or ""
    element._searchKey = string.lower(element._searchName)
    if tab and tab._items then
        table.insert(tab._items, element)
    end
    if opts.Flag then
        Library.Flags[opts.Flag] = element
        if window then
            window:_flagCreated(opts.Flag, element)
        end
    end
    element._userVisible = opts.Visible ~= false
    function element:IsVisible()
        return element._userVisible
    end
    function element:_isShown()
        return element._userVisible and not (tab and tab._userVisible == false)
    end
    function element:SetVisible(visible)
        visible = visible and true or false
        if visible == element._userVisible or element._destroyed then
            return
        end
        element._userVisible = visible
        if not visible then
            if element._onHide then
                element._onHide()
            end
            if element.Open and type(element.SetOpen) == "function" then
                element:SetOpen(false)
            end
        end
        if frame then
            frame.Visible = visible
        end
        if window then
            window._controlsDirty = true
        end
    end
    if frame and not element._userVisible then
        frame.Visible = false
    end
    -- Tooltip: a string, or { Title, Text, Icon }. nil, false or "" hides it.
    function element:SetTooltip(tip)
        element._tooltip = tip
        if frame and window and not element._tooltipBound then
            element._tooltipBound = true
            window:_attachTooltip(element, frame)
        end
    end
    function element:GetTooltip()
        return element._tooltip
    end
    if opts.Tooltip ~= nil and opts.Tooltip ~= false then
        element:SetTooltip(opts.Tooltip)
    end
    function element:Destroy()
        if element._destroyed then
            return
        end
        element._destroyed = true
        if window and window._tipOwner == element then
            window:_hideTooltip()
        end
        for _, disconnect in ipairs(element._listeners) do
            disconnect()
        end
        element._listeners = {}
        if tab and tab._items then
            local index = table.find(tab._items, element)
            if index then
                table.remove(tab._items, index)
            end
        end
        if opts.Flag and Library.Flags[opts.Flag] == element then
            Library.Flags[opts.Flag] = nil
        end
        if window then
            window._controlsDirty = true
        end
        if frame then
            frame:Destroy()
        end
    end
    return element
end

local LUCIDE_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Footagesus/Icons/refs/heads/main/lucide/dist/Icons.lua"
local lucideSet = nil

local function loadLucide()
    if lucideSet ~= nil then
        return lucideSet
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        local source = game:HttpGet(LUCIDE_URL)
        return loadstring(source)()
    end)
    if ok and type(result) == "table" then
        lucideSet = result
    else
        lucideSet = false
        warn("[Noir] lucide icons unavailable: " .. tostring(result))
    end
    return lucideSet
end

local FONT_PRESETS = {
    ValleySans = {
        Regular = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelsinkiTypeStudio/valley-sans/main/fonts/ttf/ValleySans-Regular.ttf",
        Medium = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelsinkiTypeStudio/valley-sans/main/fonts/ttf/ValleySans-Medium.ttf",
        SemiBold = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelsinkiTypeStudio/valley-sans/main/fonts/ttf/ValleySans-SemiBold.ttf",
    },
}

local FONT_WEIGHTS = {
    Regular = { 400, Enum.FontWeight.Regular },
    Medium = { 500, Enum.FontWeight.Medium },
    SemiBold = { 600, Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold },
    Bold = { 700, Enum.FontWeight.Bold },
}

function Library:LoadFont(opts)
    opts = normalize(opts, {})
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" or typeof(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
        warn("[Noir] custom fonts need writefile, isfile and getcustomasset")
        return false
    end
    local name = opts.Name or "CustomFont"
    local weights = opts.Weights or FONT_PRESETS[name]
    if type(weights) ~= "table" then
        warn("[Noir] no font weights for " .. name)
        return false
    end
    local folder = opts.Folder or "NoirFonts"
    pcall(function()
        if type(isfolder) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function" and not isfolder(folder) then
            makefolder(folder)
        end
    end)
    local faces = {}
    for weightName, url in pairs(weights) do
        local info = FONT_WEIGHTS[weightName]
        if info then
            local path = folder .. "/" .. name .. "-" .. weightName .. ".ttf"
            local ok = true
            if not isfile(path) then
                ok = pcall(function()
                    writefile(path, game:HttpGet(url))
                end)
            end
            if ok then
                table.insert(faces, { name = weightName, weight = info[1], style = "normal", assetId = getcustomasset(path) })
            else
                warn("[Noir] could not download " .. weightName .. " weight of " .. name)
            end
        end
    end
    if #faces == 0 then
        return false
    end
    local familyPath = folder .. "/" .. name .. ".json"
    local okWrite = pcall(function()
        writefile(familyPath, HttpService:JSONEncode({ name = name, faces = faces }))
    end)
    if not okWrite then
        return false
    end
    local family = getcustomasset(familyPath)
    local function face(weightName, fallback)
        local info = FONT_WEIGHTS[weightName]
        if info and weights[weightName] then
            return Font.new(family, info[2])
        end
        return fallback
    end
    Library.Fonts.Regular = face("Regular", Library.Fonts.Regular)
    Library.Fonts.Medium = face("Medium", face("Regular", Library.Fonts.Medium))
    Library.Fonts.Bold = face("SemiBold", face("Bold", Library.Fonts.Bold))
    return true
end

function Library:PreloadIcons()
    return loadLucide() ~= false
end

-- Numbers, digit strings and asset URLs are custom images; anything else is
-- a lucide name.
local function assetId(value)
    if type(value) == "number" then
        return "rbxassetid://" .. string.format("%.0f", value)
    end
    if type(value) == "string" then
        if value:match("^%d+$") then
            return "rbxassetid://" .. value
        end
        if value:find("^rbxassetid://") or value:find("^rbxasset://") or value:find("^rbxthumb://") or value:find("^http") or (Assets and value == Assets.Logo) then
            return value
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Returns image, rect offset, rect size, whether it is a custom image, and
-- whether that custom image should still take the theme tint.
local function resolveIcon(icon)
    if typeof(icon) == "table" then
        return assetId(icon.Image) or icon.Image, icon.RectOffset, icon.RectSize, true, icon.Tint == true
    end
    local asset = assetId(icon)
    if asset then
        return asset, nil, nil, true, false
    end
    if type(icon) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local name = icon:gsub("^lucide:", "")
    local set = loadLucide()
    if not set then
        return nil
    end
    local entry = (set.Icons and set.Icons[name]) or set[name]
    if type(entry) == "table" then
        local image = entry.Image
        if type(image) == "number" then
            image = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(image)
        end
        local sheet = (set.Spritesheets and set.Spritesheets[tostring(image)]) or image
        return sheet, entry.ImageRectPosition, entry.ImageRectSize
    elseif type(entry) == "string" then
        return entry
    end
    warn("[Noir] unknown lucide icon: " .. name)
    return nil
end

-- The Noir mark (NOIR CREATOR), embedded as a PNG so it needs no upload.
-- It is written to the workspace once and loaded with getcustomasset.
local EMBEDDED_LOGO = __noirAsset("EMBEDDED_LOGO.png")

local function decodeBase64(data)
    local lookup = {}
    local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    for i = 1, #alphabet do
        lookup[alphabet:byte(i)] = i - 1
    end
    local out = {}
    for i = 1, #data, 4 do
        local a, b, c, d = data:byte(i, i + 3)
        local n = lookup[a] * 262144 + lookup[b] * 4096 + (lookup[c] or 0) * 64 + (lookup[d] or 0)
        local x, y, z = n // 65536, n // 256 % 256, n % 256
        if d ~= 61 then
            out[#out + 1] = string.char(x, y, z)
        elseif c ~= 61 then
            out[#out + 1] = string.char(x, y)
        else
            out[#out + 1] = string.char(x)
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

pcall(function()
    local getasset = (typeof(getcustomasset) == "function" and getcustomasset)
        or (typeof(getsynasset) == "function" and getsynasset)
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" or typeof(getasset) ~= "function" then
        return
    end
    local folder = "NoirAssets"
    if type(isfolder) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function" and not isfolder(folder) then
        makefolder(folder)
    end
    local path = folder .. "/CybrionLogo.png"
    local png = type(EMBEDDED_LOGO) == "string" and decodeBase64(EMBEDDED_LOGO) or nil
    local fresh = type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and isfile(path) and readfile(path) == png
    if not fresh then
        writefile(path, png)
    end
    local asset = getasset(path)
    if type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
        Assets.Logo = asset
    end
end)

local tweenInfoCache = {}

-- Theme bindings: every instance property painted with a theme color is
