                local arr = {}
                for _,v in pairs(Tex) do
                    local d = Instance.new("Decal")
                    d.Texture = v
                    arr[#arr+1]=d
                end
                pcall(function() game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(arr) end)
                for _,v in ipairs(arr) do pcall(function() v:Destroy() end) end
            end)

            -- pooling beams
            local function acquireBeam()
                local V = table.remove(G.pool)
                if V and V.b.Parent and V.a0.Parent and V.a1.Parent then
                    return V
                end
                local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
                a0.Name = "NoirTracerA"
                a0.Parent = Terrain
                local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
                a1.Name = "NoirTracerB"
                a1.Parent = Terrain
                local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
                beam.Name = "NoirTracer"
                beam.Attachment0, beam.Attachment1 = a0, a1
                beam.FaceCamera = true
                beam.LightEmission, beam.LightInfluence = 1, 0
                beam.Enabled = false
                beam.Parent = Terrain
                V = {a0=a0, a1=a1, b=beam}
                G.made[#G.made+1]=V
                return V
            end
            local function releaseBeam(V)
                if not V then return end
                pcall(function() V.b.Enabled = false end)
                if #G.pool < 160 then
                    G.pool[#G.pool+1]=V
                else
                    pcall(function() V.b:Destroy(); V.a0:Destroy(); V.a1:Destroy() end)
                end
            end

            -- raycast helper
            local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
            rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            pcall(function() rayParams.RespectCanCollide = true end)
            local rayUpdate = 0
            local function getRayParams()
                if os.clock() - rayUpdate > 1 then
                    rayUpdate = os.clock()
                    local list = {}
                    for _,pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if pl.Character then list[#list+1]=pl.Character end
                    end
                    local cam = Workspace_local.CurrentCamera
                    if cam then list[#list+1]=cam end
                    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = list
                end
                return rayParams
            end
            local function isObstructed(a,b)
                local dir = b - a
                if dir.Magnitude < 0.05 then return nil end
                -- try single ray, allow transparent parts
                local cur = a
                for i=1,5 do
                    local hit = Workspace_local:Raycast(cur, b - cur, getRayParams())
                    if not hit then return nil end
                    local transp = 0
                    pcall(function() transp = hit.Instance.Transparency end)
                    if transp < 0.85 then return hit end
                    cur = hit.Position + dir.Unit * 0.05
                    if (b - cur):Dot(dir.Unit) <= 0 then return nil end
                end
                return nil
            end

            -- path finder wrapper (path finder)
            local function buildPathfinder(s, e)
                local ok, pts = pcall(function()
                    local path = PathService:CreatePath({AgentRadius=1.5, AgentHeight=5, AgentCanJump=true, AgentCanClimb=true, WaypointSpacing=6})
                    path:ComputeAsync(s - Vector3.new(0,2.5,0), e - Vector3.new(0,2.5,0))
                    if path.Status ~= Enum.PathStatus.Success then return nil end
                    local arr = {s}
                    for _,wp in ipairs(path:GetWaypoints()) do
                        arr[#arr+1]= wp.Position + Vector3.new(0,3,0)
                    end
                    arr[#arr+1]= e
                    return arr
                end)
                if not ok or type(pts)~="table" then return nil end
                local len=0
                for i=1,#pts-1 do len += (pts[i+1]-pts[i]).Magnitude end
                if len > (e-s).Magnitude*4+40 then return nil end
                return pts
            end

            -- smoothing like catmull
            local function smoothPoints(pts)
                if #pts<=2 then return pts end
                local out = {pts[1]}
                local total=0
                for i=1,#pts-1 do total += (pts[i+1]-pts[i]).Magnitude end
                local step = math.max(2.2, total/44)
                for i=1,#pts-1 do
                    local p0 = pts[math.max(1,i-1)]
                    local p1 = pts[i]
                    local p2 = pts[i+1]
                    local p3 = pts[math.min(#pts,i+2)]
                    local segLen = (p2-p1).Magnitude
                    local cnt = math.clamp(math.floor(segLen/step+0.5),2,16)
                    for j=1,cnt do
                        local t=j/cnt
                        local t2=t*t
                        local t3=t2*t
                        local pt = 0.5*(2*p1 + (p2-p0)*t + (2*p0-5*p1+4*p2-p3)*t2 + (3*p1-p0-3*p2+p3)*t3)
                        out[#out+1]=pt
                    end
                end
                out[#out]=pts[#pts]
                return out
            end

            -- FX helpers (FX helpers)
            local function newAttachment(pos)
                local a=Instance.new("Attachment")
                a.Name="NoirTracerFx"
                a.WorldPosition=pos
                a.Parent=Terrain
                return a
            end
            local function makeEmitter(parent, props)
                local em=Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                em.Rate=0
                em.LightEmission, em.LightInfluence =1,0
                em.Speed=NumberRange.new(0)
                em.Rotation=NumberRange.new(0)
                em.RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(0)
                for k,v in pairs(props) do pcall(function() em[k]=v end) end
                em.Parent=parent
                return em
            end
            local function spawnMuzzle(pos, col)
                local a=newAttachment(pos)
                local cs=ColorSequence.new(col:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),0.55), col)
                makeEmitter(a,{Texture=Tex.star, Color=cs, Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,2.4),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)}), Lifetime=NumberRange.new(0.1), Brightness=4, ZOffset=1}):Emit(1)
                makeEmitter(a,{Texture=Tex.soft, Color=cs, Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1.8),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0.4)}), Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.2),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)}), Lifetime=NumberRange.new(0.14), Brightness=3}):Emit(1)
                local light=Instance.new("PointLight")
                light.Color, light.Range, light.Brightness = col, 9, 3.5
                light.Parent=a
                pcall(function() TweenSvc:Create(light, TweenInfo.new(0.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Brightness=0}):Play() end)
                task.delay(0.5,function() pcall(function() a:Destroy() end) end)
            end
            local function spawnImpact(pos, col)
                local a=newAttachment(pos)
                local cs=ColorSequence.new(col:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),0.6), col)
                makeEmitter(a,{Texture=Tex.star, Color=cs, Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,3.6),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)}), Lifetime=NumberRange.new(0.2), Brightness=4, ZOffset=1}):Emit(1)
                makeEmitter(a,{Texture=Tex.ring, Color=cs, Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.4),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,5.5)}), Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)}), Lifetime=NumberRange.new(0.35), Brightness=3}):Emit(1)
                makeEmitter(a,{Texture=Tex.dot, Color=cs, Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.45),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)}), Speed=NumberRange.new(12,30), SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180), Acceleration=Vector3.new(0,-45,0), Drag=3, Lifetime=NumberRange.new(0.3,0.6), Brightness=3}):Emit(18)
                makeEmitter(a,{Texture=Tex.soft, Color=cs, Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,2.6),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0.6)}), Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.3),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)}), Lifetime=NumberRange.new(0.25), Brightness=2}):Emit(1)
                local light=Instance.new("PointLight")
                light.Color, light.Range, light.Brightness = col,12,3.5
                light.Parent=a
                pcall(function() TweenSvc:Create(light, TweenInfo.new(0.3,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Brightness=0}):Play() end)
                task.delay(1.2,function() pcall(function() a:Destroy() end) end)
            end
            local function getColors(opts)
                local rainbow = opts.rainbow
                if rainbow==nil then rainbow = G.rainbow end
                if rainbow then
                    local h=os.clock()*0.18%1
                    return Color3.fromHSV(h,0.7,1), Color3.fromHSV((h+0.18)%1,0.75,1)
                end
                return opts.col or G.col, opts.col2 or G.col2
            end

            -- core builder (builder)
            local function buildTracer(pts, opts)
                opts = opts or {}
                if #pts < 2 then return end
                while #G.live >= 8 do
                    local old = table.remove(G.live,1)
                    for _,row in ipairs(old.rows) do for _,b in ipairs(row) do releaseBeam(b) end end
                    if old.head then pcall(function() old.head:Destroy() end) end
                end
                -- cumulative lengths
                local cum = {0}
                for i=2,#pts do cum[i]= cum[i-1]+(pts[i]-pts[i-1]).Magnitude end
                local total=cum[#cum]
                if total <0.5 then return end
                local style = Styles[opts.style or G.style] or Styles.Energy
                local col, col2 = getColors(opts)
                local wk = (opts.width or G.width or 100)/100
                -- wk scaled by stretch
                -- build rows
                local rows = {}
                for li, layer in ipairs(style) do
                    local row={}
                    for i=1,#pts-1 do
                        local b = acquireBeam()
                        local beam=b.b
                        beam.Texture = Tex[layer.tex]
                        if layer.wrap then
                            beam.TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Wrap
                            beam.TextureLength = layer.wrap * wk
                        else
                            beam.TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Stretch
                            beam.TextureLength = 1
                        end
                        beam.TextureSpeed = layer.spd
                        beam.Brightness = layer.br
                        beam.Segments = (#pts==2 and 24 or 4)
                        beam.ZOffset = li*0.05
                        b.a0.WorldPosition = pts[i]
                        b.a1.WorldPosition = pts[i+1]
                        beam.Enabled=false
                        row[i]=b
                    end
                    rows[li]=row
                end
                local tracer = {
                    pts=pts, cum=cum, L=total, t0=os.clock(), rows=rows, style=style, col=col, col2=col2, wk=wk,
                    speed= math.max(40, opts.speed or G.speed or 520),
                    life= math.max(0.2, opts.life or G.life or 1.2),
                    impact = opts.impact,
                    landed=false,
                }
                tracer.tail = opts.tail or math.clamp(total*0.45, 8, 60)
                tracer.clearHead = opts.clearHead
                if opts.muzzle then pcall(spawnMuzzle, pts[1], col) end
                -- head fx
                local head = newAttachment(pts[1])
                makeEmitter(head,{Texture=Tex.dot, Color=ColorSequence.new(col:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),0.5)), Size=NumberSequence.new(2.8*wk), Lifetime=NumberRange.new(total/tracer.speed+0.05), LockedToPart=true, Brightness=5, ZOffset=1}):Emit(1)
                makeEmitter(head,{Texture=Tex.star, Color=ColorSequence.new(col:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),0.35)), Size=NumberSequence.new(3.4*wk), Lifetime=NumberRange.new(total/tracer.speed+0.05), LockedToPart=true, Brightness=4, ZOffset=1.1}):Emit(1)
                tracer.trail = makeEmitter(head,{Texture=Tex.dot, Color=ColorSequence.new(col:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),0.3), col2), Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.32*wk),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)}), Speed=NumberRange.new(1.5,5), SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180), Drag=4, Lifetime=NumberRange.new(0.2,0.42), Rate=70, Brightness=3})
                tracer.head = head
                G.live[#G.live+1]=tracer
                if opts.cb then task.spawn(opts.cb, tracer) end
                return tracer
            end

            local function pointOnPath(tr, dist)
                local cum, pts = tr.cum, tr.pts
                if dist <=0 then return pts[1],1 end
                if dist >= tr.L then return pts[#pts], #pts-1 end
                local lo,hi=1,#cum
                while hi-lo>1 do
                    local mid=(lo+hi)//2
                    if cum[mid]<=dist then lo=mid else hi=mid end
                end
                local segLen = cum[lo+1]-cum[lo]
                local t = segLen>0 and (dist-cum[lo])/segLen or 0
                return pts[lo]:Lerp(pts[lo+1], t), lo
            end

            -- heartbeat updater (Updater)
            local function updateTracers()
                if #G.live==0 then return end
                local now=os.clock()
                local i=1
                while i <= #G.live do
                    local tr = G.live[i]
                    local elapsed = now - tr.t0
                    local total, speed = tr.L, tr.speed
                    local headDist = math.min(total, elapsed*speed)
                    local tailDist = elapsed*speed - tr.tail
                    local totalTime = total/speed
                    if not tr.landed and headDist >= total then
                        tr.landed=true
                        if tr.trail then tr.trail.Rate=0 end
                        if tr.clearHead and tr.head then
                            for _,ch in ipairs(tr.head:GetChildren()) do
                                if ch:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and ch~=tr.trail then pcall(function() ch:Clear() end) end
                            end
                        end
                        if tr.impact then pcall(spawnImpact, tr.pts[#tr.pts], tr.col) end
                    end
                    local fade = 0.38
                    if elapsed > totalTime then
                        fade = 0.38 * math.clamp(1-(elapsed-totalTime)/tr.life,0,1)^1.5
                    end
                    local shouldRemove = elapsed > totalTime + tr.life and tailDist >= total
                    if shouldRemove then
                        for _,row in ipairs(tr.rows) do for _,b in ipairs(row) do releaseBeam(b) end end
                        pcall(function() tr.head:Destroy() end)
                        table.remove(G.live,i)
                    else
                        local headPos = pointOnPath(tr, headDist)
                        if tr.head then tr.head.WorldPosition = headPos end
                        local visibleTail = math.max(tailDist,0.01)
                        local function alphaAt(d)
                            if d>=tailDist and d<=headDist+0.001 then
                                return ((d-tailDist)/math.max(headDist-tailDist,0.01))^1.4
                            end
                            return 0
                        end
                        local isStraight = #tr.pts==2
                        for li, row in ipairs(tr.rows) do
                            local layer = tr.style[li]
                            local baseA = layer.a
                            for segIdx, b in ipairs(row) do
                                local segStart = tr.cum[segIdx]
                                local segEnd = tr.cum[segIdx+1]
                                if segStart >= headDist or (fade<=0.004 and segEnd <= tailDist) then
                                    if b.b.Enabled then b.b.Enabled=false end
                                else
                                    local segTail = math.min(segEnd, headDist)
                                    -- update attachments
                                    if segEnd > headDist then
                                        b.a1.WorldPosition = headPos
                                    else
                                        b.a1.WorldPosition = tr.pts[segIdx+1]
                                    end
                                    local segLen = segTail - segStart
                                    -- transparency keys
                                    local keys={}
                                    local steps = isStraight and 9 or 2
                                    for s=0,steps-1 do
                                        local t = steps==1 and 0 or s/(steps-1)
                                        local dist = segStart + (segEnd-segStart)*t
                                        -- clamp to visible segment
                                        if dist < tailDist then dist = tailDist end
                                        if dist > segTail then dist = segTail end
                                        keys[#keys+1]= NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, math.clamp(1 - alphaAt(dist)*baseA,0,1))
                                    end
                                    -- if straight need more keys
                                    if not isStraight and #keys==2 then
                                        -- keep 2 keys
                                    end
                                    b.b.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(keys)
                                    local a0 = math.max(alphaAt(segStart),0)
                                    local a1 = math.max(alphaAt(segEnd),0)
                                    local w0 = 0.9*layer.w*tr.wk*(0.55+0.45*a0)
                                    local w1 = 0.9*layer.w*tr.wk*(0.55+0.45*a1)
                                    b.b.Width0, b.b.Width1 = w0, w1
                                    local colA = tr.col2:Lerp(tr.col, segStart/total):Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1), layer.mix)
                                    local colB = tr.col2:Lerp(tr.col, segEnd/total):Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1), layer.mix)
                                    b.b.Color = ColorSequence.new(colA, colB)
                                    if not b.b.Enabled then b.b.Enabled=true end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        i+=1
                    end
                end
            end
            RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function() pcall(updateTracers) end)

            -- path builder wrapper (builder)
            local function spawnFromTo(a, b, impact, muzzle, extra)
                extra = extra or {}
                local opts = {impact=impact, muzzle=muzzle, speed=extra.speed, life=extra.life, cb=extra.cb}
                if (b-a).Magnitude > 700 then b = a + (b-a).Unit*700 end
                if G.method == "Path Finder" then
                    local startTime=os.clock()
                    -- try direct first
                    local directPts, reason
                    -- simplified: try to use isObstructed
                    if not isObstructed(a,b) then
                        directPts, reason = {a,b}, "direct"
                    else
                        -- try simple waypoint offset sampling like Tracer Y (simplified placeholder)
                        directPts = nil
                    end
                    if directPts then
                        local pts = smoothPoints(directPts)
                        logTracer(string.format("PF %s pts=%d %.1fms", reason or "?", #pts, (os.clock()-startTime)*1000))
                        return buildTracer(pts, opts)
                    end
                    -- fallback to pathfinder async
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local st=os.clock()
                        local pts = buildPathfinder(a,b)
                        if pts then
                            pts = smoothPoints(pts)
                            logTracer(string.format("PF nav pts=%d %.1fms", #pts, (os.clock()-st)*1000))
                            buildTracer(pts, opts)
                        else
                            logTracer("PF fallback straight")
                            buildTracer({a,b}, opts)
                        end
                    end)
                    return
                end
                return buildTracer({a,b}, opts)
            end

            G.build = spawnFromTo
            -- helper to find origin from character/gun like Updater
            local function findOrigin(char, part, vec)
                local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local att = hrp and hrp:FindFirstChild("GunRaycastAttachment")
                if att then return att.WorldPosition end
                if typeof(part)=="Instance" and part:IsA("BasePart") then return part.Position end
                if typeof(vec)=="Vector3" then return vec end
                return nil
            end

            -- hook firing: wrap fireGunAt after it exists + listen to GunFired event
            local function hookFireGunAt()
                task.spawn(function()
                    local tries=0
                    local orig
                    while tries < 80 do
                        tries+=1
                        orig = rawget(getgenv(), "fireGunAt") or _G.fireGunAt or getgenv().fireGunAt
                        if typeof(orig)=="function" then break end
                        task.wait(0.25)
                    end
                    if typeof(orig)~="function" then
                        -- also try NoirGenv
                        local ok, env = pcall(NoirGenv)
                        if ok and type(env)=="table" then orig = env.fireGunAt end
                    end
                    if typeof(orig)~="function" then return end
                    if orig.__tracerWrapped then return end
                    local wrapped = function(plr, usePred)
                        local ok, res = pcall(orig, plr, usePred)
                        if G.on and plr and typeof(plr)=="Instance" then
                            pcall(function()
                                local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
                                local handle=nil
                                if myChar then
                                    local gun=myChar:FindFirstChild("Gun")
                                    if not gun then
                                        local bp=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
                                        if bp then gun=bp:FindFirstChild("Gun") end
                                    end
                                    if gun then handle=gun:FindFirstChild("Handle",true) end
                                end
                                local origin = handle and handle.Position or (myChar and myChar:GetPivot().Position) or nil
                                local targetPart = nil
                                if plr.Character then
                                    targetPart = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
                                end
                                local dest = targetPart and targetPart.Position or nil
                                if origin and dest then
                                    spawnFromTo(origin, dest, G.impact, G.muzzle)
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                        return ok and res or false
                    end
                    wrapped.__tracerWrapped=true
                    _G.fireGunAt = wrapped
                    getgenv().fireGunAt = wrapped
                    pcall(function() NoirGenv().fireGunAt = wrapped end)
                    logTracer("hooked fireGunAt")
                end)
            end
            hookFireGunAt()

            -- GunFired hook (Tracer style) for other shots
            task.spawn(function()
                local ok, obj = pcall(function() return ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ClientServices",5) end)
                local ws = ok and obj and obj:FindFirstChild("WeaponService")
                local ev = ws and ws:FindFirstChild("GunFired")
                if not (ev and ev:IsA("RemoteEvent")) then
                    -- also try MM2 path: ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
                    local ok2, rem = pcall(function() return ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") end)
                    if rem then
                        -- listen to any ChildAdded Shoot events as fallback via DescendantAdded handled by fireGunAt hook
                    end
                    return
                end
                -- simple connection helper
                ev.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
                    local args={...}
                    task.spawn(function()
                        pcall(function()
                            -- GunFired logic simplified: args[1]=shooter char/instance?, args[3]=target Vector3
                            -- try to extract Vector3 target
                            local target=nil
                            for _,v in ipairs(args) do if typeof(v)=="Vector3" then target=v end end
                            if not target or not G.on then return end
                            local shooter = args[1]
                            local originPart = args[2]
                            local isMe = false
                            local char = typeof(shooter)=="Instance" and shooter or nil
                            while char and not (char:IsA("Model") and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) do char=char.Parent end
                            if char and char==LocalPlayer.Character then isMe=true end
                            if not isMe and not G.others then return end
                            local origin = findOrigin(char, originPart, nil)
                            if not origin then
                                local myChar=LocalPlayer.Character
                                origin = myChar and myChar:GetPivot().Position or target
                            end
                            spawnFromTo(origin, target, G.impact, G.muzzle)
                        end)
                    end)
                end)
                logTracer("GunFired hook armed")
            end)

            -- preview helper
            G.preview = function(vec, extra)
                if G.previewing then return end
                local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
                local hrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local cam = Workspace_local.CurrentCamera
                if not (hrp and cam) then return end
                G.previewing=true
                local origin = (myChar:GetPivot() * CFrame.new(1.4,1.25,-3.45)).Position
                local target
                if typeof(vec)=="Vector3" then
                    target=vec
                else
                    -- find nearest around
                    local best, bestDist=nil, 1e9
                    for _,pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if pl~=LocalPlayer and pl.Character then
                            local hr = pl.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            local hum = pl.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            if hr and hum and hum.Health>0 then
                                local d=(hr.Position-origin).Magnitude
                                if d>12 and d<260 and d<bestDist then best, bestDist = hr.Position, d end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if best then target=best else
                        local dir = cam.CFrame.LookVector
                        local flat = Vector3.new(dir.X,0,dir.Z)
                        flat = flat.Magnitude>0.1 and flat.Unit or cam.CFrame.LookVector
                        local hit = Workspace_local:Raycast(origin, flat*140+Vector3.new(0,2,0), getRayParams())
                        target = hit and hit.Position or origin+flat*140
                    end
                end
                extra = extra or {}
                extra.cb = function(tr) G._lastPreview=tr end
                spawnFromTo(origin, target, true, true, extra)
                local start=os.clock()
                while not G._lastPreview and os.clock()-start<2 do task.wait() end
                local tr=G._lastPreview; G._lastPreview=nil
                if not tr then G.previewing=false; return end
                -- camera chase (simplified)
                local startCam=cam.CFrame.Position
                local dir=(target-origin).Unit
                local endPos=target
                cam.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
                local ok=pcall(function()
                    local conn
                    conn=RunService:BindToRenderStep("NoirTracerCam", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+2, function(dt)
                        if not G.previewing then return end
                        local elapsed=os.clock()-tr.t0
                        local headDist=math.min(tr.L, elapsed*tr.speed)
                        local headPos, _ = pointOnPath(tr, headDist)
                        local t = headPos - origin
                        if t.Magnitude>0.05 then dir=t.Unit end
                        local off = Vector3.new(0,2.4,0) + dir:Cross(Vector3.yAxis).Unit*5
                        if off.Magnitude<0.1 then off=Vector3.new(5,2.4,0) end
                        local camPos = headDist<tr.L and (headPos - dir*5.5 + Vector3.new(0,2.4,0)) or (endPos + Vector3.new(9,3,0))
                        local look = headDist<tr.L and (headPos + dir*2.5) or endPos
                        startCam = startCam:Lerp(camPos, 1-math.exp(-(dt or 0.016)*14))
                        cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(startCam, look)
                    end)
                end)
                local dur = tr.L/tr.speed
                local endT=os.clock()
                while os.clock()-endT < math.min(dur+1.5,9) and G.previewing do task.wait() end
                pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("NoirTracerCam") end)
                pcall(function() cam.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Custom; cam.CameraSubject = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") end)
                G.previewing=false
            end

            -- UI рядом с Silent Aim
            pcall(function()
                combatAim:AddToggle("Bullet Tracers", function(v) G.on = v==true end)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                combatAim:AddDropdown("Tracer Method", {"Classic","Path Finder"}, function(v) if v=="Classic" or v=="Path Finder" then G.method=v end end)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                combatAim:AddDropdown("Tracer Style", StyleList, function(v) if Styles[v] then G.style=v end end)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                combatAim:AddColorpicker("Tracer Color", G.col, function(c) if typeof(c)=="Color3" then G.col=c end end)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                combatAim:AddColorpicker("Tail Color", G.col2, function(c) if typeof(c)=="Color3" then G.col2=c end end)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                combatAim:AddToggle("Rainbow Tracers", function(v) G.rainbow = v==true end)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                combatAim:AddSlider("Tracer Width", 40, 250, 100, function(v) G.width = tonumber(v) or 100 end)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                combatAim:AddSlider("Tracer Speed", 150, 1500, 520, function(v) G.speed = tonumber(v) or 520 end)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                combatAim:AddSlider("Tracer Duration", 3, 40, 12, function(v) G.life = (tonumber(v) or 12)/10 end)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                combatAim:AddToggle("Impact Effect", function(v) G.impact = v==true end)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                combatAim:AddToggle("Muzzle Flash", function(v) G.muzzle = v==true end)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                combatAim:AddToggle("Show Other Shots", function(v) G.others = v==true end)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                combatAim:AddButton("Preview Tracer", function() task.spawn(function() pcall(G.preview) end) end)
            end)
            combatAim:AddLabel("Стили: Energy/Laser/Lightning/Plasma/Fire/Smoke/Stardust. Preview — камера преследует трейсер.")
        end

         
        do
            local globals = NoirGenv()
            local oldPrediction = globals.__NoirPredictionRuntime
            if type(oldPrediction) == "table" and type(oldPrediction.Stop) == "function" then pcall(oldPrediction.Stop) end
            local oldOmega = globals.__NoirOmegaRuntime
            if type(oldOmega) == "table" and type(oldOmega.Stop) == "function" then pcall(oldOmega.Stop) end
            globals.__NoirOmegaRuntime = nil

            local SAMPLE_INTERVAL = 0.4
            local MONITOR_INTERVAL = 0.25
            local STALE_INTERVAL = 5
            local HYSTERESIS = 4
            local statsService = game:GetService("Stats")
            local profileState = {
                alive = true, initializing = true,
                enabled = true, adaptive = true, locked = false, upgrade = false, monitor = false, fpsBoost = false,
                lastApply = -math.huge, currentProfile = "--", classicIndex = nil,
                rawPing = 60, smoothedPing = 60, jitter = 0, pingSource = "Fallback",
                lastAttempt = -math.huge, lastGoodSample = -math.huge,
                workerToken = nil, monitorGui = nil, monitorLabels = nil, lastSummary = nil,
            }

                        if profileState.enabled ~= true then profileState.enabled = true end
local function warnOnce(key, message)
                profileState.warnings = profileState.warnings or {}
                if not profileState.warnings[key] then
                    profileState.warnings[key] = true
                    warn("[Noir Auto] " .. message)
                end
            end
            local function isFinite(value)
                return type(value) == "number" and value == value
                    and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
            end
            local function readStat(folderName, itemName)
                local folder = statsService:FindFirstChild(folderName)
                local item = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(itemName)
                if not item then return nil end
                local ok, value = pcall(function() return item:GetValue() end)
                return ok and value or nil
            end
            local function readNetworkPing()
                local ok, value = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() end)
                if ok and isFinite(value) then return value * 1000 end
            end
            local pingReaders = {
                { function() return readStat("Network", "Data Ping") end, "Data Ping" },
                { function() return readStat("PerformanceStats", "Ping") end, "Performance" },
                { readNetworkPing, "Network" },
            }
            local function samplePing(force)
                local now = os.clock()
                if not force and now - profileState.lastAttempt < SAMPLE_INTERVAL then return end
                profileState.lastAttempt = now
                local value
                for _, reader in ipairs(pingReaders) do
                    local ok, candidate = pcall(reader[1])
                    if ok and isFinite(candidate) and candidate > 0 then
                        value = candidate
                        profileState.pingSource = reader[2]
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not value then
                    profileState.pingSource = profileState.lastGoodSample == -math.huge and "Fallback" or "Last known"
                    return
                end
                local elapsed = now - profileState.lastGoodSample
                local nextRaw = math.clamp(math.floor(value + 0.5), 5, 1200)
                if elapsed > STALE_INTERVAL then
                    profileState.smoothedPing = nextRaw
                    profileState.jitter = 0
                else
                    local weight = elapsed / SAMPLE_INTERVAL
                    local jitterAlpha = 1 - 0.75 ^ weight
                    profileState.jitter = profileState.jitter
                        + (math.abs(nextRaw - profileState.rawPing) - profileState.jitter) * jitterAlpha
                    if profileState.adaptive then
                        local alpha = math.abs(nextRaw - profileState.smoothedPing) > 40 and 0.6 or 0.25
                        alpha = 1 - (1 - alpha) ^ weight
                        profileState.smoothedPing = profileState.smoothedPing
                            + (nextRaw - profileState.smoothedPing) * alpha
                    else
                        profileState.smoothedPing = nextRaw
                    end
                end
                profileState.rawPing = nextRaw
                profileState.lastGoodSample = now
            end
            local function getPing()
                return math.floor(profileState.smoothedPing + 0.5)
            end
            local function getConfig(ping)
                local first, second, blend, name
                if profileState.adaptive then
                    name = "Dynamic " .. tostring(math.floor(ping)) .. " ms"
                    first, second = PingProfiles[1], PingProfiles[1]
                    if ping >= PingProfiles[#PingProfiles].Ping then
                        first, second = PingProfiles[#PingProfiles], PingProfiles[#PingProfiles]
                    elseif ping > first.Ping then
                        for i = 1, #PingProfiles - 1 do
                            if ping <= PingProfiles[i + 1].Ping then
                                first, second = PingProfiles[i], PingProfiles[i + 1]
                                blend = (ping - first.Ping) / (second.Ping - first.Ping)
                                blend = blend * blend * (3 - 2 * blend)
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    blend = blend or 0
                else
                    local thresholds = { 50, 100, 150 }
                    local index = profileState.classicIndex
                    if index then
                        while index < 4 and ping > thresholds[index] + HYSTERESIS do index += 1 end
                        while index > 1 and ping <= thresholds[index - 1] - HYSTERESIS do index -= 1 end
                    else
                        index = 1
                        while index < 4 and ping > thresholds[index] do index += 1 end
                    end
                    profileState.classicIndex = index
                    first = PingProfiles[index + 1] or PingProfiles[#PingProfiles]
                    second, blend = first, 0
                    name = "Classic " .. string.char(64 + index)
                end
                local function mix(key, scale)
                    local value = first[key] + (second[key] - first[key]) * blend
                    scale = scale or 1
                    return math.floor(value * scale + 0.5) / scale
                end
                local result = {
                    Name = name,
                    Sim = mix("Sim"), Interval = mix("Interval"),
                    H = mix("H"), V = mix("V"),
                    X = mix("X"), Y = mix("Y"), Z = mix("Z"),
                }
                if profileState.upgrade then
                    result.Sim += 1
                    result.H += 2
                    result.V += 2
                end
                return result
            end

            local statusControl
            local function tr(value)
                if type(NoirTr) == "function" then return NoirTr(value) end
                return value
            end
            local function displayProfile()
                if profileState.currentProfile == "--" then return "--" end
                local letter = string.match(profileState.currentProfile, "Classic ([A-D])$")
                if letter then return tr("Classic") .. " " .. letter end
                return tr("Dynamic") .. " " .. tostring(getPing()) .. " " .. tr("ms")
            end
            local function setText(labelObject, value)
                if labelObject and labelObject.Parent and labelObject.Text ~= value then labelObject.Text = value end
            end
            local function statusText()
                local mode = profileState.adaptive and tr("Adaptive") or tr("Classic")
                local current = not profileState.enabled and tr("OFF")
                    or profileState.locked and tr("LOCKED") or tr("ON")
                return string.format("%s: %s | %d %s | %s | %s%s",
                    tr("Noir Auto"), current, getPing(), tr("ms"), mode, displayProfile(),
                    profileState.upgrade and (" " .. tr("+Upgrade")) or "")
            end
            local function refreshStatus()
                local summary = statusText()
                if statusControl and type(statusControl.SetValue) == "function"
                    and profileState.lastSummary ~= summary then
                    profileState.lastSummary = summary
                    statusControl:SetValue(summary)
                end
                local labels = profileState.monitorLabels
                if labels then
                    local mode = profileState.adaptive and tr("Adaptive") or tr("Classic")
                    local current = not profileState.enabled and tr("OFF")
                        or profileState.locked and tr("LOCKED") or tr("ON")
                    setText(labels.state, current .. " • " .. mode .. (profileState.upgrade and " • " .. tr("UPGRADE") or ""))
                    setText(labels.config, tostring(getPing()) .. " " .. tr("ms") .. " • " .. displayProfile())
                    setText(labels.values, string.format("S:%s I:%s H/V:%s/%s",
                        tostring(config.maxSimulationMs), tostring(config.predictionIntervalMs),
                        tostring(config.horizontalMultiplier), tostring(config.verticalMultiplier)))
                    setText(labels.source, tr("Jitter") .. ": " .. tostring(math.floor(profileState.jitter + 0.5))
                        .. " " .. tr("ms") .. " • " .. tr(profileState.pingSource))
                end
            end
            local function destroyMonitor()
                if profileState.monitorGui then
                    pcall(function() profileState.monitorGui:Destroy() end)
                    profileState.monitorGui = nil
                end
                profileState.monitorLabels = nil
                local parent = guiParent
                if typeof(parent) ~= "Instance" then
                    parent = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
                end
                if parent then
                    local stale = parent:FindFirstChild("NoirAutoPredictionMonitor")
                    if stale then pcall(function() stale:Destroy() end) end
                end
            end
            local function createMonitor()
                if profileState.monitorGui and profileState.monitorGui.Parent then return end
                destroyMonitor()
                local parent = guiParent
                if typeof(parent) ~= "Instance" then parent = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") end
                if typeof(parent) ~= "Instance" then
                    warnOnce("monitor-parent", "Monitor UI parent is unavailable.")
                    profileState.monitor = false
                    return
                end
                local screen = New("ScreenGui", {
                    Parent = parent, Name = "NoirAutoPredictionMonitor", ResetOnSpawn = false,
                    IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 82, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
                })
                local card = New("Frame", {
                    Parent = screen, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 54),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(205, 82), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 12, 16),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.22, BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true,
                })
                corner(card, 11)
                stroke(card, C.accent, 0.62)
                local function line(name, y, color, size, bold)
                    return New("TextLabel", {
                        Parent = card, Name = name, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, y),
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Text = "", TextColor3 = color, TextSize = size,
                        Font = bold and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.Gotham,
                        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                    })
                end
                line("Title", 4, C.text, 9, true).Text = tr("NOIR AUTO PREDICTION")
                profileState.monitorGui = screen
                profileState.monitorLabels = {
                    state = line("State", 19, C.dim, 8, false),
                    config = line("Profile", 34, C.dim, 8, false),
                    values = line("Values", 49, C.dim, 8, false),
                    source = line("Source", 64, C.dim, 7, false),
                }
                refreshStatus()
            end
            local function syncControl(key, value)
                local control = noirMirrorControls["pistol." .. key]
                if type(control) ~= "table" or type(control.SetValue) ~= "function" then return end
                local ok, current = pcall(function() return control:GetValue() end)
                if ok and tonumber(current) == tonumber(value) then return end
                -- Auto ping is transient; update the slider without writing a file every sample.
                pcall(function() control:SetValue(value, false) end)
            end
            local function syncControls(profile, ping)
                config.maxSimulationMs = profile.Sim
                config.predictionIntervalMs = profile.Interval
                config.offsetX, config.offsetY, config.offsetZ = profile.X, profile.Y, profile.Z
                config.horizontalMultiplier, config.verticalMultiplier = profile.H, profile.V
                config.manualPingMs = ping
                syncControl("maxSimulationMs", profile.Sim)
                syncControl("predictionIntervalMs", profile.Interval)
                syncControl("offsetX", profile.X)
                syncControl("offsetY", profile.Y)
                syncControl("offsetZ", profile.Z)
                syncControl("horizontalMultiplier", profile.H)
                syncControl("verticalMultiplier", profile.V)
                syncControl("manualPingMs", ping)
            end
            local function applyProfile(force)
                if not profileState.alive then return end
                local now = os.clock()
                if not force and now - profileState.lastApply < SAMPLE_INTERVAL then return end
                profileState.lastApply = now
                samplePing(force == true)
                if not profileState.enabled or profileState.locked then
                    refreshStatus()
                    return
                end
                local ping = getPing()
                local values = getConfig(ping)
                syncControls(values, ping)
                profileState.currentProfile = values.Name
                profileState.applyHealthy = true
                refreshStatus()
            end
            local function needsUpdates()
                return profileState.monitor or (profileState.enabled and not profileState.locked)
            end
            local function syncWorker()
                if not profileState.alive or not needsUpdates() then
                    profileState.workerToken = nil
                    return
                end
                if profileState.workerToken then return end
                local token = {}
                profileState.workerToken = token
                task.spawn(function()
                    while profileState.alive and profileState.workerToken == token and needsUpdates() do
                        task.wait(profileState.monitor and MONITOR_INTERVAL or SAMPLE_INTERVAL)
                        if profileState.alive and profileState.workerToken == token and needsUpdates() then
                            if profileState.enabled and not profileState.locked then
                                applyProfile(false)
                            else
                                samplePing(false)
                            end
                            refreshStatus()
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            local function reconfigure(invalidate)
                if invalidate then profileState.lastApply = -math.huge end
                if profileState.enabled and not profileState.locked then
                    applyProfile(true)
                else
                    refreshStatus()
                end
                syncWorker()
            end
            local function telemetry()
                samplePing(true)
                if profileState.enabled and not profileState.locked then applyProfile(true) end
                local mode = profileState.adaptive and tr("Adaptive") or tr("Classic")
                local summary = string.format("%s=%d %s | %s=%d | %s=%d | %s=%s | %s=%s | %s=%s",
                    tr("Ping"), getPing(), tr("ms"), tr("Raw"), profileState.rawPing,
                    tr("Jitter"), math.floor(profileState.jitter + 0.5), tr("Source"), tr(profileState.pingSource),
                    tr("Profile"), displayProfile(), tr("Mode"), mode)
                notify(summary, 4)
                            end

            local persistence = NoirPersistence and NoirPersistence.data and NoirPersistence.data.toggles
            local profileFpsKey = "Noir Auto prediction profile::FPS Boost"
            local hubFpsKey = "MISC • FPS::FPS Boost"
            local fpsBoostToggle
            local function syncFPSBoostToHub(value)
                local desired = value == true
                if type(persistence) == "table" then persistence[hubFpsKey] = desired end
                globals.__NoirFPSRequestedBoost = desired
                local runtime = globals.__NoirFPSBoostRuntime
                local current
                if type(runtime) == "table" and type(runtime.Get) == "function" then
                    local ok, result = pcall(runtime.Get)
                    if ok then current = result end
                end
                if current == desired then return true end
                local previous = globals.__NoirFPSSyncing == true
                globals.__NoirFPSSyncing = true
                local control = globals.__NoirFPSBoostToggle
                local ok
                if type(control) == "function" then
                    ok = pcall(control, desired)
                elseif type(runtime) == "table" and type(runtime.Set) == "function" then
                    ok = pcall(runtime.Set, desired)
                end
                globals.__NoirFPSSyncing = previous
                return ok ~= false
            end
            if type(persistence) == "table" then
                local function migrate(label, oldLabel, defaultValue)
                    local key = "Noir Auto prediction profile::" .. label
                    if persistence[key] == nil then
                        local oldValue = persistence["SILENT AIM::" .. oldLabel]
                        persistence[key] = type(oldValue) == "boolean" and oldValue or defaultValue
                        return true
                    end
                    return false
                end
                local changed = false
                changed = migrate("Auto Prediction", "Omega Auto Revert", true) or changed
                changed = migrate("Adaptive Engine", "Omega Adaptive Engine", true) or changed
                changed = migrate("Lock Config", "Omega Lock Config", false) or changed
                changed = migrate("Upgrade Mode", "Omega Upgrade Mode", false) or changed
                changed = migrate("Monitor", "Omega Monitor", false) or changed
                if persistence[profileFpsKey] == nil then
                    local oldFPS = persistence[hubFpsKey]
                    persistence[profileFpsKey] = type(oldFPS) == "boolean" and oldFPS or false
                    changed = true
                end
                if type(persistence[profileFpsKey]) == "boolean"
                    and persistence[hubFpsKey] ~= persistence[profileFpsKey] then
                    persistence[hubFpsKey] = persistence[profileFpsKey]
                    changed = true
                end
                if changed and NoirPersistence and type(NoirPersistence.Save) == "function" then
                    pcall(NoirPersistence.Save)
                end
            end
            globals.__NoirSetPredictionFPSBoost = function(value)
                local desired = value == true
                if type(persistence) == "table" then
                    persistence[profileFpsKey] = desired
                    persistence[hubFpsKey] = desired
                end
                globals.__NoirFPSRequestedBoost = desired
                local changed = profileState.fpsBoost ~= desired
                profileState.fpsBoost = desired
                if changed and not profileState.initializing and type(fpsBoostToggle) == "function" then
                    local previous = globals.__NoirFPSSyncing == true
                    globals.__NoirFPSSyncing = true
                    pcall(fpsBoostToggle, desired)
                    globals.__NoirFPSSyncing = previous
                end
            end

            local predictionSection = tab:AddSection("Noir Auto prediction profile", "Ping-adaptive Silent Aim prediction")
            predictionSection:AddToggle("Auto Prediction", function(value)
                profileState.enabled = value == true
                if not profileState.initializing then
                    reconfigure(true)
                    notify(tr("Auto Prediction") .. ": " .. tr(profileState.enabled and "ON" or "OFF"), 2)
                end
            end)
            predictionSection:AddToggle("Adaptive Engine", function(value)
                local nextValue = value == true
                if profileState.adaptive ~= nextValue then
                    profileState.adaptive = nextValue
                    profileState.classicIndex = nil
                    profileState.smoothedPing = profileState.rawPing
                end
                if not profileState.initializing then
                    reconfigure(true)
                    notify(tr("Adaptive Engine") .. ": " .. tr(profileState.adaptive and "ON" or "OFF"), 2)
                end
            end)
            predictionSection:AddToggle("Lock Config", function(value)
                profileState.locked = value == true
                if not profileState.initializing then
                    reconfigure(not profileState.locked)
                    notify(tr("Config") .. ": " .. tr(profileState.locked and "LOCKED" or "UNLOCKED"), 2)
                end
            end)
            predictionSection:AddToggle("Upgrade Mode", function(value)
                profileState.upgrade = value == true
                if not profileState.initializing then
                    reconfigure(true)
                    notify(tr("Upgrade Mode") .. ": " .. tr(profileState.upgrade and "ON" or "OFF"), 2)
                end
            end)
            predictionSection:AddToggle("Monitor", function(value)
                profileState.monitor = value == true
                if not profileState.initializing then
                    if profileState.monitor then
                        samplePing(true)
                        createMonitor()
                    else
                        destroyMonitor()
                    end
                    refreshStatus()
                    syncWorker()
                end
            end)
            fpsBoostToggle = predictionSection:AddToggle("FPS Boost", function(value)
                profileState.fpsBoost = value == true
                if not profileState.initializing and globals.__NoirFPSSyncing ~= true then
                    syncFPSBoostToHub(profileState.fpsBoost)
                end
            end)
            predictionSection:AddButton("Print Telemetry", telemetry)
            statusControl = predictionSection:AddLabel("")
            predictionSection:AddLabel("Noir Auto updates gun prediction using ping. Turning it off stops updates and keeps the last values.")
            predictionSection:AddLabel("FPS Boost is shared with the hub's MISC • FPS control.")

            profileState.initializing = false
            syncFPSBoostToHub(profileState.fpsBoost)
            if profileState.monitor then
                samplePing(true)
                createMonitor()
            end
            if profileState.enabled and not profileState.locked then applyProfile(true) end
            refreshStatus()
            syncWorker()

            globals.__NoirPredictionRuntime = {
                Stop = function()
                    if not profileState.alive then return end
                    profileState.alive = false
                    profileState.workerToken = nil
                    destroyMonitor()
                end,
                Sync = function()
                    if profileState.enabled and not profileState.locked then applyProfile(true)
                    else refreshStatus() end
                end,
            }
        end

        combatAim:AddLabel("GUN UTILITIES • native Noir implementation")
        combatAim:AddParagraph("GUN TRIGGER BOT", "Shoots once when the centre cursor/crosshair points at the Murderer. Works with mobile Shift Lock; move off target and back to arm the next shot.")
        combatAim:AddToggle("Gun Trigger Bot", function(v) config.gunTriggerBot = v == true end)
        combatAim:AddToggle("Gun Trigger Bot Wall Check", function(v) config.gunTriggerBotWallCheck = v == true end)
        combatAim:AddToggle("Apply Prediction On Gun Trigger Bot", function(v) config.gunTriggerBotPrediction = v == true end)

        local combatGun=tab:AddSection("GUN", "Gun targeting controls")
            combatGun:AddToggle("Piercer Bullet", setPiercerBullet)
        combatGun:AddLabel("If a wall is between you and the target, the shot starts on their side of the wall. Turn this on with Silent Aim.")

        local combatKnife=tab:AddSection("KNIFE SILENT AIM", "Nearest player or Sheriff-only targeting")
        combatKnife:AddToggle("Knife Silent Aim", function(v)
            config.knifeEnabled=v==true
            if config.knifeEnabled then installHook() end
        end)
         
        local oldKnifeAuraKey = "KNIFE SILENT AIM::Knife Radius"
        local newKnifeAuraKey = "KNIFE SILENT AIM::Knife Throw Aura"
        if NoirPersistence.data.sliders[newKnifeAuraKey] == nil and NoirPersistence.data.sliders[oldKnifeAuraKey] ~= nil then
            NoirPersistence.data.sliders[newKnifeAuraKey] = NoirPersistence.data.sliders[oldKnifeAuraKey]
            NoirPersistence.Save()
        end
         
         
        local knifeAuraToggle = combatKnife:AddToggle("KnifeThrown Aura", function(v) config.knifeThrownAura=v==true end)
        if NoirPersistence.data.toggles["KNIFE SILENT AIM::KnifeThrown Aura"] == nil then
            knifeAuraToggle(true)
        end
        combatKnife:AddSlider("Knife Throw Aura", 1, 40, config.knifeRadius, function(v) config.knifeRadius = tonumber(v) or config.knifeRadius end)
        combatKnife:AddToggle("Knife Wall Check", function(v) config.knifeWallCheck=v==true end)
        combatKnife:AddToggle("Prioritize Sheriff", function(v)
            config.knifePrioritizeSheriff=v==true
        end)
        combatKnife:AddLabel("NATIVE KNIFE UTILITIES • equipped Knife only")
        local function refreshKnifeUtilities()
            local runtime = NoirGenv().__NoirKnifeUtilityRuntime
            if type(runtime) == "table" and type(runtime.Refresh) == "function" then pcall(runtime.Refresh, runtime) end
        end
        local function knifeRuntimeCall(method)
            local runtime = NoirGenv().__NoirKnifeUtilityRuntime
            if type(runtime) == "table" and type(runtime[method]) == "function" then return runtime[method](runtime) end
            notify("Knife utilities are starting", 2)
            return nil
        end
        combatKnife:AddToggle("Instant Throw", function(v)
            config.knifeInstantThrow = v == true
            if config.knifeInstantThrow then installHook() end
        end)
        combatKnife:AddToggle("Fast Throw", function(v)
            config.knifeFastThrow = v == true
            if config.knifeFastThrow then installHook() end
        end)
        combatKnife:AddToggle("Auto Kill Everyone", function(v) config.knifeAutoKillEveryone = v == true end)
        combatKnife:AddToggle("Auto Kill Sheriff", function(v) config.knifeAutoKillSheriff = v == true end)
        combatKnife:AddButton("Kill Everyone", function() knifeRuntimeCall("KillEveryone") end)
        combatKnife:AddButton("Kill Sheriff", function() knifeRuntimeCall("KillSheriff") end)
        combatKnife:AddToggle("Enable Kill Sheriff Bindable Button", function(v) config.knifeSheriffBind = v == true; refreshKnifeUtilities() end)
        local function knifePlayerChoices()
            local values = { "N/A" }
            for _, player in ipairs(getPlayers()) do if player ~= LocalPlayer then values[#values + 1] = player.Name end end
            table.sort(values, function(a, b) if a == "N/A" then return true elseif b == "N/A" then return false end return string.lower(a) < string.lower(b) end)
            return values
        end
        local selectedKnifePlayer = combatKnife:AddDropdown("Kill Player", knifePlayerChoices(), function(v) config.knifeKillPlayer = tostring(v or "N/A") end)
        combatKnife:AddButton("Kill Player", function() knifeRuntimeCall("KillSelected") end)
        combatKnife:AddButton("Refresh Kill Player List", function() selectedKnifePlayer:Refresh(knifePlayerChoices(), config.knifeKillPlayer) end)
        local function refreshKnifePlayerList()
            if selectedKnifePlayer and selectedKnifePlayer.Refresh then
                selectedKnifePlayer:Refresh(knifePlayerChoices(), config.knifeKillPlayer)
            end
        end
        Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function() task.delay(.15, refreshKnifePlayerList) end)
        Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function() task.delay(.15, refreshKnifePlayerList) end)

        local function addPrediction(section,profile,prefix)
            local function addToggle(key,label)
                local control=section:AddToggle(label,function(v) profile[key]=v==true end)
                noirMirrorControls[prefix..key]=control
                revertToggleStates[prefix..key]=profile[key]==true
            end
            local function addSlider(key,label,min,max)
                local control=section:AddSlider(label,min,max,tonumber(profile[key]) or min,function(v) profile[key]=tonumber(v) or profile[key] end)
                noirMirrorControls[prefix..key]=control
                if key=="manualPingMs" then noirMirrorControls[prefix=="knife." and "knifeManualPingMs" or "manualPingMs"]=control end
            end
            addToggle("prioritizePing","Prioritize Your Ping")
            addToggle("predictJump","Predict Jump")
            addToggle("predictLag","Predict Lag")
            addSlider("maxSimulationMs","Prediction Max Simulation",20,300)
            addSlider("predictionIntervalMs","Prediction Interval",1,100)
            addSlider("manualPingMs","Prediction Ping",10,1000)
            addSlider("offsetX","X Position Offset",-100,100)
            addSlider("offsetY","Y Position Offset",-100,100)
            addSlider("offsetZ","Z Position Offset",-100,100)
            addSlider("horizontalMultiplier","Horizontal Multiplier",0,400)
            addSlider("verticalMultiplier","Vertical Multiplier",0,400)
            addSlider("leadScale","Lead Scale",25,250)
        end

        local pistolPrediction=tab:AddSection("PISTOL PREDICTION", "Independent server-shot prediction")
        addPrediction(pistolPrediction,config,"pistol.")
        local knifePrediction=tab:AddSection("KNIFE PREDICTION", "Independent KnifeThrown prediction")
        addPrediction(knifePrediction,config.knifeAim,"knife.")

        local profileKeys={"adaptive","fixedLead","extraLead","prioritizePing","predictJump","predictLag","maxSimulationMs","predictionIntervalMs","manualPingMs","offsetX","offsetY","offsetZ","horizontalMultiplier","verticalMultiplier","leadScale"}
        local function profileSnapshot(profile)
            local data={}
            for _,key in ipairs(profileKeys) do data[key]=profile[key] end
            return data
        end
        local function applyProfile(profile,data)
            if typeof(data)~="table" then return false end
            for _,key in ipairs(profileKeys) do
                if typeof(data[key])==typeof(profile[key]) then profile[key]=data[key] end
            end
            if type(syncRevertControls)=="function" then syncRevertControls() end
            return true
        end
        local function profilePresetNames(kind)
            local names={"default"}
            if type(listfiles)=="function" then
                ensurePresetFolder()
                local ok,files=pcall(listfiles,PRESET_FOLDER)
                if ok and typeof(files)=="table" then
                    local suffix="_"..string.lower(kind).."%.preset$"
                    for _,file in ipairs(files) do
                        local base=tostring(file):gsub("\\","/"):match("([^/]+)"..suffix)
                        if base and not table.find(names,base) then names[#names+1]=base end
                    end
                end
            end
            table.sort(names)
            return names
        end
        local function addProfileConfig(title,kind,profile)
            local section=tab:AddSection(title,"Independent "..kind.." preset storage")
            local selected="default"
            section:AddDropdown("Your Presets",profilePresetNames(kind),function(v) selected=cleanPresetName(v) end)
            section:AddTextBox("Preset Name",function(v) selected=cleanPresetName(v) end)
            section:AddButton("Save "..kind.." Preset",function()
                if type(writefile)~="function" then notify("Executor does not support writefile",4) return end
                ensurePresetFolder()
                local payload={version=4,kind=string.lower(kind),profile=profileSnapshot(profile)}
                local ok,encoded=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(payload) end)
                local path=PRESET_FOLDER.."/"..selected.."_"..string.lower(kind)..".preset"
                if ok and pcall(writefile,path,xorPreset(encoded)) then notify(kind.." preset saved: "..selected,3) else notify(kind.." preset save failed",4) end
            end)
            section:AddButton("Load "..kind.." Preset",function()
                if type(readfile)~="function" then notify("Executor does not support readfile",4) return end
                local path=PRESET_FOLDER.."/"..selected.."_"..string.lower(kind)..".preset"
                local ok,data=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(xorPreset(readfile(path))) end)
                if ok and typeof(data)=="table" and data.kind==string.lower(kind) and applyProfile(profile,data.profile) then notify(kind.." preset loaded: "..selected,3) else notify(kind.." preset not found or invalid",4) end
            end)
        end
        addProfileConfig("PISTOL NOIR CONFIG","Pistol",config)
        addProfileConfig("KNIFE NOIR CONFIG","Knife",config.knifeAim)

        syncRevertControls=function()
            for _,entry in ipairs({
                {"pistol.prioritizePing",config.prioritizePing},{"pistol.predictJump",config.predictJump},{"pistol.predictLag",config.predictLag},
                {"knife.prioritizePing",config.knifeAim.prioritizePing},{"knife.predictJump",config.knifeAim.predictJump},{"knife.predictLag",config.knifeAim.predictLag}
            }) do
                local control=noirMirrorControls[entry[1]]
                if type(control)=="function" then pcall(control,entry[2]) end
            end
            for _,entry in ipairs({
                {"pistol.maxSimulationMs",config.maxSimulationMs},{"pistol.predictionIntervalMs",config.predictionIntervalMs},{"pistol.manualPingMs",config.manualPingMs},
                {"pistol.offsetX",config.offsetX},{"pistol.offsetY",config.offsetY},{"pistol.offsetZ",config.offsetZ},{"pistol.horizontalMultiplier",config.horizontalMultiplier},{"pistol.verticalMultiplier",config.verticalMultiplier},
                {"knife.maxSimulationMs",config.knifeAim.maxSimulationMs},{"knife.predictionIntervalMs",config.knifeAim.predictionIntervalMs},{"knife.manualPingMs",config.knifeAim.manualPingMs},
                {"knife.offsetX",config.knifeAim.offsetX},{"knife.offsetY",config.knifeAim.offsetY},{"knife.offsetZ",config.knifeAim.offsetZ},{"knife.horizontalMultiplier",config.knifeAim.horizontalMultiplier},{"knife.verticalMultiplier",config.knifeAim.verticalMultiplier}
            }) do
                local control=noirMirrorControls[entry[1]]
                if type(control)=="table" and type(control.SetValue)=="function" then pcall(control.SetValue,control,entry[2]) end
            end
        local predictionRuntime = NoirGenv().__NoirPredictionRuntime
        if type(predictionRuntime) == "table" and type(predictionRuntime.Sync) == "function" then predictionRuntime.Sync() end
        end
        syncRevertControls()
    end
    buildCombatControls()
end

local remoteConnections = {}
function connectRemote(name, handler)
    local wanted = string.lower(tostring(name))
    local first
    for _, remote in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
        if string.lower(remote.Name) == wanted then
            if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                first = first or remote
                table.insert(remoteConnections, remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...) pcall(handler, ...) end))
            elseif remote:IsA("BindableEvent") then
                first = first or remote
                table.insert(remoteConnections, remote.Event:Connect(function(...) pcall(handler, ...) end))
            end
        end
    end
    return first
end

connectRemote("PlayerDataChanged", function(first, second)
    if typeof(second) == "table" and typeof(first) == "Instance" and first:IsA("Player") then
        consumeData({ [first.Name] = second }, false)
    else
        consumeData(first, false)
    end
end)
connectRemote("RoundStart", function(timerValue, roundData)
    beginRoundTimer(timerValue)
    murderer, sheriff, hero = nil, nil, nil
    table.clear(roleCache); table.clear(announcedRoles)
    if typeof(roundData) == "table" then consumeData(roundData, true) end
    refreshTarget(true)
end)
local function finishRound()
    resetRoundTimer()
    murderer, sheriff, hero = nil, nil, nil
    table.clear(roleCache); table.clear(announcedRoles)
end
connectRemote("RoundEndFade", finishRound)
connectRemote("RoundEnd", finishRound)
connectRemote("RoleSelect", function() task.spawn(refreshTarget) end)
connectRemote("ShowRoleSelect", function() task.spawn(refreshTarget) end)
connectRemote("ShowRoleSelectNew", function() task.spawn(refreshTarget) end)
connectRemote("ChangeTarget", function() task.spawn(refreshTarget) end)
connectRemote("GiveWeapon", function() task.spawn(refreshTarget) end)
connectRemote("KillEvent", function() task.spawn(refreshTarget) end)
connectRemote("GameOver", finishRound)
connectRemote("VictoryScreen", finishRound)
connectRemote("Stealth", function() notify("Stealth activated", 3) end)

        updatePing()

        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

    while running do
        refreshTarget()
        task.wait(instantRoleDetection and 0.5 or 2)
    end
end)

    while running do
        if config.enabled or config.knifeEnabled then
            local part = targetPart()
            local settings = config.enabled and config or config.knifeAim
            if part then sampleMotion(part, settings) end
        end
        task.wait(1 / 30)
    end
end)

aimHeld = (config.aimKey == "None")
UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
        local key = input.KeyCode.Name
        if key == config.aimKey then aimHeld = true end
        if key == config.autoFireKey then autoFireHeld = true end
        if key == config.toggleKey and config.toggleKey ~= "None" then toggle(not config.enabled) end
    elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        if config.aimKey == "MouseButton1" then aimHeld = true end
        if config.autoFireKey == "MouseButton1" then autoFireHeld = true end
    elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        if config.aimKey == "Touch" then aimHeld = true end
        if config.autoFireKey == "Touch" then autoFireHeld = true end
    end
end)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
        local key = input.KeyCode.Name
        if key == config.aimKey then aimHeld = false end
        if key == config.autoFireKey then autoFireHeld = false end
    elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        if config.aimKey == "MouseButton1" then aimHeld = false end
        if config.autoFireKey == "MouseButton1" then autoFireHeld = false end
    elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        if config.aimKey == "Touch" then aimHeld = false end
        if config.autoFireKey == "Touch" then autoFireHeld = false end
    end
end)

do
    local function makeWorldPluginTab(base)
        local proxy = {}
        setmetatable(proxy, {
            __index = function(_, key)
                if key == "AddSection" then
                    return function(_, name, description)
                        name = tostring(name or "Plugin")
                        if string.sub(name, 1, 6) ~= "WORLD " then
                            name = "WORLD • " .. name
                        end
                        return base:AddSection(name, description or "")
                    end
                end
                local method = base[key]
                if type(method) == "function" then
                    return function(_, ...)
                        return method(base, ...)
                    end
                end
                return method
            end,
        })
        return proxy
    end
    local odh_shared_plugins = {
        game_name = "Murder Mystery 2",
        CreateTab = function(_, title, icon)
            return makeWorldPluginTab(host.CreateTab())
        end,
        Notify = function(textValue, duration)
            notify(tostring(textValue), duration or 3)
        end,
    }
    do
        local __pluginOk, __pluginError = xpcall(function()

local allowed={}
for key in pairs(runtime.selections) do
    allowed[key]={}
    for _,name in ipairs(key=="run" and runAnimOptions or allAnimOptions) do allowed[key][name]=true end
end
local function LoadSettings()
    if not canPersist then
        WarnOnce("filesystem","readfile/writefile unavailable; settings are session-only.")
        return
    end
    if type(fileExists)=="function" then
        local ok,exists=pcall(fileExists,FILE)
        if ok and not exists then return end
    end
    local ok,text=pcall(fileRead,FILE)
    if not ok then
        if type(fileExists)=="function" then
            runtime.saveStatus="Read error"
            WarnOnce("read","Cannot read the settings file.")
        end
        return
    end
    local decoded,data=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(text) end)
    if not decoded or type(data)~="table" or data.version~=1 or type(data.selections)~="table" then
        runtime.saveStatus="Invalid file"
        WarnOnce("read","Invalid settings file; kept unchanged until you edit a setting.")
        return
    end
    if type(data.enabled)=="boolean" then runtime.enabled=data.enabled end
    for key in pairs(runtime.selections) do
        local value=data.selections[key]
        if type(value)=="string" and allowed[key][value] then runtime.selections[key]=value end
    end
    runtime.saveStatus="Loaded"
end
local function SaveSettings()
    if not runtime.alive or runtime.initializing or not canPersist then return false end
    local ok,err=pcall(function()
        fileWrite(FILE,HttpService:JSONEncode({version=1,enabled=runtime.enabled,selections=runtime.selections}))
    end)
    if not ok then
        runtime.saveStatus="Write error"
        WarnOnce("write","Cannot save settings: "..tostring(err))
        return false
    end
    warnings.write=nil
    runtime.saveStatus="Saved"
    return true
end
