-- нечего — список в меню есть, на ноже пусто. Добавлен источник 7: процедурная
-- генерация спеков для КАЖДОГО ключа Database.Sync.Effects (цвет и стиль
-- детерминированы именем эффекта), свой дропдаун «Game Effect (visual)» как
-- гарантированный путь equip, снайфер и скан моделей подменяют сгенерированные
-- спеки настоящими, как только добывают их с чужих ножей.
-- v1.4.3 (почему «эффекты не выбираются»): список дропдауна наполнялся ТОЛЬКО из
-- рантайма тоггла — если старт рантайма падал (профиль игры не найден) или
-- откладывался, в дропдауне навсегда оставался один «None». Теперь список
-- наполняется прямо из Database.Sync.Effects при построении меню; выбор работает
-- и с выключенным тогглом (рантайм стартует сам); выбор пишется в профиль игры и
-- на диск (Noir/mm2_fx.json) и восстанавливается после релога; клик «Equip» на
-- эффекте в РОДНОМ инвентаре игры тоже надевает эффект локально; unlock больше
-- не падает целиком из-за отсутствия профиля.
-- Почему «эффекты появились, но не видны»: игра отдаёт инвентарь клиента, но
-- частицы эффекта на ноже строит СЕРВЕР (по настоящему владению). Сама по себе
-- подмена profile.Effects.Owned даёт только список в игровом меню. Этот модуль,
-- как и Pulse, доделывает вторую половину: держит эффекты разблокированными и
-- строит эффект локально на ноже (в руке + на лобби-дисплее + на визуале
-- скинченджера). Источники спецификаций эффекта, по приоритету (первый
-- непустой для эффекта побеждает, источники дополняют друг друга):
--   1) кэш Pulse: PulseHub/cache/fx_effects.7c12eb2e.txt (проверка размера/CRC);
--   2) наша копия дампа: NoirMM2/fx_effects.txt;
--   3) кэш снайффера: NoirMM2/fx_sniff.txt (снято с реальных ножей в игре);
--   4) данные игры: Database.Sync.Effects (если в записи есть спеки инстансов);
--   5) модели в ReplicatedStorage/PlayerGui, названные как эффекты;
--   6) живой снайффер: раз в секунду снимает эффекты с ножей персонажей.
-- Формат спека — «плоский» диалект Pulse: список {cls=, nm=, attCF=, a0CF=,
-- a1CF=, <свойство>=значение}; типизированные значения кодируются тегом:
-- {1,r,g,b}=Color3, {2,x,y,z}=Vector3, {3,x,y}=Vector2, {4,min,max}=NumberRange,
-- {5,t,v,e...}=NumberSequence, {6,t,r,g,b...}=ColorSequence, {7,12чисел}=CFrame,
-- {8,EnumType,EnumName}=Enum. Грамматика снята с aura_data из офлайн-сборки
-- Pulse и проверена побайтово (hash 2564895108).
-- ВАЖНО: эффект виден только вам (клиент) — сервер чужие эффекты не реплицирует.

local NoirFX = {}
local FX_CLASSES = {ParticleEmitter = true, Trail = true, Beam = true, Fire = true, Smoke = true, Sparkles = true, PointLight = true, SpotLight = true}
local FX_RESERVED = {cls = true, nm = true, par = true, attCF = true, a0CF = true, a1CF = true, c = true, n = true, p = true, k = true, i = true, g = true, s = true, cf = true, h = true, r6 = true}
local FX_CLASS_CODES = {P = "ParticleEmitter", T = "Trail", B = "Beam", F = "Fire", S = "Smoke", K = "Sparkles", L = "PointLight", G = "SpotLight"}
local FX_PROPS = {
        ParticleEmitter = {"Texture", "Color", "LightEmission", "LightInfluence", "Size", "Transparency", "Lifetime", "Rate", "Speed", "SpreadAngle", "Rotation", "RotSpeed", "Acceleration", "Drag", "LockedToPart", "EmissionDirection", "VelocityInheritance", "ZOffset", "TimeScale", "FlipbookLayout", "FlipbookMode", "FlipbookFramerate", "Brightness", "Enabled"},
        Trail = {"Texture", "Color", "Transparency", "Lifetime", "WidthScale", "LightEmission", "LightInfluence", "FaceCamera", "TextureMode", "TextureLength", "MinLength", "Enabled"},
        Beam = {"Texture", "Color", "Transparency", "Width0", "Width1", "LightEmission", "LightInfluence", "Segments", "CurveSize0", "CurveSize1", "TextureMode", "TextureLength", "FaceCamera", "Brightness", "Enabled"},
        Fire = {"Color", "SecondaryColor", "Heat", "Size", "Enabled"},
        Smoke = {"Color", "Opacity", "RiseVelocity", "Size", "Enabled"},
        Sparkles = {"Color", "SparkleColor", "Enabled"},
        PointLight = {"Brightness", "Color", "Range", "Shadows", "Enabled"},
        SpotLight = {"Brightness", "Color", "Range", "Angle", "Face", "Shadows", "Enabled"},
}
local FX_PULSE_PATH = "PulseHub/cache/fx_effects.7c12eb2e.txt"
local FX_PULSE_SIZE = 479845
local FX_PULSE_HASH = 2081614638
local FX_OWN_PATH = "NoirMM2/fx_effects.txt"
local FX_SNIFF_PATH = "NoirMM2/fx_sniff.txt"

NoirFX.diag = function(message)
        pcall(function()
                local globals = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
                local text = tostring(globals.__NoirSkinsDiag or "")
                if #text > 12000 then text = string.sub(text, -6000) end
                globals.__NoirSkinsDiag = text .. "fx: " .. tostring(message) .. "\n"
        end)
end

local function fxNotify(text)
        pcall(function()
            local starterGui = game and game.GetService and game:GetService("StarterGui")
            if starterGui then
                starterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "Noir • Effects", Text = tostring(text), Duration = 5})
            end
        end)
end

-- снимок живых инстансов -> плоские спеки (диалект Pulse, значения с тегами)
NoirFX.encodeValue = function(value)
        local kind = typeof and typeof(value) or type(value)
        if kind == "Color3" then return {1, value.R, value.G, value.B} end
        if kind == "Vector3" then return {2, value.X, value.Y, value.Z} end
        if kind == "Vector2" then return {3, value.X, value.Y} end
        if kind == "NumberRange" then return {4, value.Min, value.Max} end
        if kind == "NumberSequence" then
                local out = {5}
                for _, keypoint in ipairs(value.Keypoints) do
                        out[#out + 1] = keypoint.Time
                        out[#out + 1] = keypoint.Value
                        out[#out + 1] = keypoint.Envelope
                end
                return out
        end
        if kind == "ColorSequence" then
                local out = {6}
                for _, keypoint in ipairs(value.Keypoints) do
                        out[#out + 1] = keypoint.Time
                        out[#out + 1] = keypoint.Value.R
                        out[#out + 1] = keypoint.Value.G
                        out[#out + 1] = keypoint.Value.B
                end
                return out
        end
        if kind == "CFrame" then
                local out = {7}
                local components = {value:GetComponents()}
                for index = 1, 12 do out[index + 1] = components[index] end
                return out
        end
        if kind == "EnumItem" then return {8, tostring(value.EnumType), tostring(value.Name)} end
        if kind == "number" or kind == "string" or kind == "boolean" then return value end
        return nil
end

local function decodeTyped(environment, value)
        if type(value) ~= "table" then
                if type(value) == "string" then
                        local group, name = string.match(value, "^Enum%.([%w_]+)%.([%w_]+)$")
                        if group then
                                local ok, item = pcall(function() return environment.Enum[group][name] end)
                                return ok and item or nil
                        end
                end
                return value
        end
        local tag = value[1]
        if tag == 1 then return environment.Color3.new(value[2], value[3], value[4]) end
        if tag == 2 then return environment.Vector3.new(value[2], value[3], value[4]) end
        if tag == 3 then return environment.Vector2.new(value[2], value[3]) end
        if tag == 4 then return environment.NumberRange.new(value[2], value[3] or value[2]) end
        if tag == 5 then
                local points = {}
                local index = 2
                while index + 2 <= #value do
                        points[#points + 1] = environment.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(value[index], value[index + 1], value[index + 2] or 0)
                        index = index + 3
                end
                local ok, sequence = pcall(environment.NumberSequence.new, points)
                return ok and sequence or nil
        end
        if tag == 6 then
                local points = {}
                local index = 2
                while index + 3 <= #value do
                        points[#points + 1] = environment.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(value[index], environment.Color3.new(value[index + 1], value[index + 2], value[index + 3]))
                        index = index + 4
                end
                local ok, sequence = pcall(environment.ColorSequence.new, points)
                return ok and sequence or nil
        end
        if tag == 7 and #value >= 13 then return environment.CFrame.new(table.unpack(value, 2, 13)) end
        if tag == 8 then
                local ok, item = pcall(function() return environment.Enum[value[2]][value[3]] end)
                return ok and item or nil
        end
        return nil
end

-- CRC дампов Pulse: FNV-подобный, шаг 5 (портирован 1:1 из pulsehub, проверен
-- на aura_data: 918986 байт -> 2564895108)
NoirFX.pulseHash = function(text)
        local hash = 2166136261
        for index = 1, #text, 5 do
                local mixed = bit32.bxor(hash, string.byte(text, index))
                hash = (mixed * 403 + bit32.lshift(mixed, 24)) % 4294967296
        end
        return hash
end

-- парсер Lua-литерала дамп («ключ»={...},...) без loadstring (строгие VM)
local FX_ESCAPES = {n = "\n", t = "\t", r = "\r", ['"'] = '"', ["'"] = "'", ["\\"] = "\\"}
NoirFX.parseLuaLiteral = function(text)
        if type(text) ~= "string" or #text < 4 then return nil end
        local position, length = 1, #text
        local parseValue, parseTable
        local function skipSpace()
                local byte = string.byte(text, position)
                while byte == 32 or byte == 9 or byte == 10 or byte == 13 do
                        position = position + 1
                        byte = string.byte(text, position)
                end
        end
        local function parseString()
                local buffer = {}
                position = position + 1
                while position <= length do
                        local byte = string.byte(text, position)
                        if byte == 34 then position = position + 1; break end
                        if byte == 92 then
                                local ch = string.sub(text, position + 1, position + 1)
                                buffer[#buffer + 1] = FX_ESCAPES[ch] or ch
                                position = position + 2
                        else
                                buffer[#buffer + 1] = string.char(byte)
                                position = position + 1
                        end
                end
                return table.concat(buffer)
        end
        local function parseNumber()
                local token = string.match(text, "^%-?%d+%.?%d*[eE][+-]?%d+", position)
                        or string.match(text, "^%-?%d+%.?%d*", position)
                        or string.match(text, "^%-?%.%d+", position)
                if not token then return nil end
                position = position + #token
                return tonumber(token)
        end
        parseTable = function()
                local arrayIndex, result = 0, {}
                position = position + 1
                while true do
                        skipSpace()
                        local byte = string.byte(text, position)
                        if not byte then return nil end
                        if byte == 125 then position = position + 1; return result end
                        if byte == 44 or byte == 59 then
                                position = position + 1
                        else
                                local key
                                if byte == 91 then
                                        position = position + 1
                                        skipSpace()
                                        if string.byte(text, position) ~= 34 then return nil end
                                        key = parseString()
                                        skipSpace()
                                        if string.byte(text, position) ~= 93 then return nil end
                                        position = position + 1
                                        skipSpace()
                                        if string.byte(text, position) ~= 61 then return nil end
                                        position = position + 1
                                else
                                        local matched = string.match(text, "^([%a_][%w_]*)%s*=", position)
                                        if matched then
                                                key = matched
                                                position = position + #matched
                                                skipSpace()
                                                if string.byte(text, position) ~= 61 then return nil end
                                                position = position + 1
                                        else
                                                arrayIndex = arrayIndex + 1
                                                key = arrayIndex
                                        end
                                end
                                local value = parseValue()
                                if value == nil then return nil end
                                result[key] = value
                        end
                end
        end
        parseValue = function()
                skipSpace()
                local byte = string.byte(text, position)
                if not byte then return nil end
                if byte == 123 then return parseTable() end
                if byte == 34 then return parseString() end
                if string.sub(text, position, position + 3) == "true" then position = position + 4; return true end
                if string.sub(text, position, position + 4) == "false" then position = position + 5; return false end
                if string.sub(text, position, position + 2) == "nil" then position = position + 3; return nil end
                return parseNumber()
        end
        local result = {}
        position = 1
        while position <= length do
                skipSpace()
                local byte = string.byte(text, position)
                if not byte then break end
                if byte == 44 then
                        position = position + 1
                elseif byte == 91 then
                        position = position + 1
                        skipSpace()
                        if string.byte(text, position) ~= 34 then return nil end
                        local key = parseString()
                        skipSpace()
                        if string.byte(text, position) ~= 93 then return nil end
                        position = position + 1
                        skipSpace()
                        if string.byte(text, position) ~= 61 then return nil end
                        position = position + 1
                        local value = parseValue()
                        if value == nil then return nil end
                        result[key] = value
                elseif byte == 123 then
                        -- дамп, обёрнутый в одну таблицу {...}
                        return parseTable()
                else
                        return nil
                end
        end
        if not next(result) then return nil end
        return result
end

NoirFX.hasFx = function(container)
        if not container or type(container.GetDescendants) ~= "function" then return false end
        for _, object in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
                if FX_CLASSES[object.ClassName] then return true end
        end
        return false
end

NoirFX.snapshot = function(state, container)
        local specs = {}
        if not container or type(container.GetDescendants) ~= "function" then return specs end
        for _, object in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
                local className = object.ClassName
                if FX_CLASSES[className] then
                        local entry = {cls = className, nm = object.Name}
                        for _, property in ipairs(FX_PROPS[className] or {}) do
                                local ok, value = pcall(function() return object[property] end)
                                if ok and value ~= nil then
                                        local encoded = NoirFX.encodeValue(value)
                                        if encoded ~= nil then entry[property] = encoded end
                                end
                        end
                        if className == "Trail" or className == "Beam" then
                                for slot, attachment in ipairs({object.Attachment0, object.Attachment1}) do
                                        if attachment then
                                                local ok, cf = pcall(function() return attachment.CFrame end)
                                                if ok and cf then
                                                        local encoded = NoirFX.encodeValue(cf)
                                                        if encoded then entry[slot == 1 and "a0CF" or "a1CF"] = encoded end
                                                end
                                        end
                                end
                        end
                        specs[#specs + 1] = entry
                end
        end
        return specs
end

NoirFX.nameCandidates = function(knife, handle, character)
        local out = {}
        local function add(value)
                if type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 and #value < 48 then out[#out + 1] = value end
        end
        -- ipairs({knife, handle, character}) ломается на первом nil (нож не в руке,
        -- а эффект висит на лобби-дисплее) — собираем список явно
        local instances = {}
        if knife then instances[#instances + 1] = knife end
        if handle then instances[#instances + 1] = handle end
        if character then instances[#instances + 1] = character end
        for _, instance in ipairs(instances) do
                if instance and type(instance.GetAttributes) == "function" then
                        local ok, attributes = pcall(function() return instance:GetAttributes() end)
                        if ok and type(attributes) == "table" then
                                for _, value in pairs(attributes) do add(value) end
                        end
                end
        end
        local pair = {}
        if knife then pair[#pair + 1] = knife end
        if handle then pair[#pair + 1] = handle end
        for _, instance in ipairs(pair) do
                if instance and type(instance.GetChildren) == "function" then
                        local ok, children = pcall(function() return instance:GetChildren() end)
                        if ok and type(children) == "table" then
                                for _, child in ipairs(children) do
                                        if child:IsA("StringValue") or child:IsA("ObjectValue") then
                                                add(child.Name)
                                                local okValue, value = pcall(function() return child.Value end)
                                                if okValue then add(tostring(value)) end
                                        end
                                end
                        end
                end
        end
        for _, instance in ipairs(pair) do
                if instance and type(instance.Name) == "string" and instance.Name ~= "Knife" and instance.Name ~= "Handle" then add(instance.Name) end
        end
        return out
end

local function normalizeName(value)
        return string.gsub(string.lower(tostring(value or "")), "[^%w]", "")
end

NoirFX.rebuildKeyMap = function(runtime)
        local map = {}
        local sync = runtime.sync
        if type(sync) == "table" and type(sync.Effects) == "table" then
                for key in pairs(sync.Effects) do
                        if type(key) == "string" then map[normalizeName(key)] = key end
                end
        end
        for key in pairs(runtime.data) do
                if type(key) == "string" and not map[normalizeName(key)] then map[normalizeName(key)] = key end
        end
        runtime.keyMap = map
end

NoirFX.resolveKey = function(runtime, knife, handle, character)
        if type(runtime.keyMap) ~= "table" or not next(runtime.keyMap) then return nil end
        for _, candidate in ipairs(NoirFX.nameCandidates(knife, handle, character)) do
                local mapped = runtime.keyMap[normalizeName(candidate)]
                if mapped then return mapped end
        end
        return nil
end

-- источник 4: Database.Sync.Effects — спеки инстансов, если игра их отдаёт
NoirFX.scanSpecs = function(state, node, depth, inheritedCF)
        -- глубина 9: записи Sync.Effects обёрнуты в массив, а спеки вида
        -- Attachment->Attachment->ParticleEmitter доходят до 5-6 уровней
        if depth > 9 or type(node) ~= "table" then return nil end
        local className = node.cls
        if not className and FX_CLASSES[node.c] then className = node.c end
        if not className and FX_CLASSES[node.n] then className = node.n end
        if not className then className = FX_CLASS_CODES[node.c] end
        if type(className) == "string" and FX_CLASSES[className] then
                local spec = {cls = className}
                if node.nm or node.n then spec.nm = node.nm or node.n end
                local specCF = node.attCF or inheritedCF
                if specCF then spec.attCF = specCF end
                if node.a0CF then spec.a0CF = node.a0CF end
                if node.a1CF then spec.a1CF = node.a1CF end
                local props = node.p
                if type(props) ~= "table" then
                        props = {}
                        for key, value in pairs(node) do
                                if not FX_RESERVED[key] then props[key] = value end
                        end
                end
                for key, value in pairs(props) do
                        if not FX_RESERVED[key] and key ~= "CFrame" then spec[key] = value end
                end
                local list = {spec}
                local children = node.k or node.children
                if type(children) == "table" then
                        for _, child in pairs(children) do
                                local sub = NoirFX.scanSpecs(state, child, depth + 1, inheritedCF)
                                if sub then
                                        for _, item in ipairs(sub) do list[#list + 1] = item end
                                end
                        end
                end
                return list
        end
        -- вложение диалекта: его CFrame (p.CFrame) наследуют дочерние FX-спеки,
        -- иначе эмиттер строится в центре хендла без смещения
        local attachmentCF = inheritedCF
        if node.c == "A" or node.n == "Attachment" or className == "Attachment" then
                local props = node.p
                if type(props) == "table" and type(props.CFrame) == "table" then attachmentCF = props.CFrame end
                if type(node.cf) == "table" then attachmentCF = node.cf end
                if type(node.attCF) == "table" then attachmentCF = node.attCF end
        end
        local all = nil
        for _, value in pairs(node) do
                local sub = NoirFX.scanSpecs(state, value, depth + 1, attachmentCF)
                if sub then
                        all = all or {}
                        for _, item in ipairs(sub) do all[#all + 1] = item end
                end
        end
        return all
end

NoirFX.fromSync = function(runtime)
        local sync = runtime.sync
        if type(sync) ~= "table" or type(sync.Effects) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        local added = 0
        for key, entry in pairs(sync.Effects) do
                if type(key) == "string" and type(entry) == "table" and not runtime.data[key] then
                        local specs = NoirFX.scanSpecs(runtime, entry, 0)
                        if specs and #specs > 0 then
                                runtime.data[key] = specs
                                added = added + 1
                        end
                end
        end
        return added
end

-- источник 5: модели в ReplicatedStorage/PlayerGui, названные как эффекты
NoirFX.fromModels = function(runtime)
        local context = runtime.context
        local containers = {}
        if context.storage then containers[#containers + 1] = context.storage end
        local playerGui = context.player and type(context.player.FindFirstChild) == "function" and context.player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if playerGui then containers[#containers + 1] = playerGui end
        if context.workspace then containers[#containers + 1] = context.workspace end
        local added, budget = 0, 5000
        local function walk(instance, depth)
                if budget <= 0 or depth > 6 or type(instance) ~= "table" then return end
                budget = budget - 1
                local okClass, isRelevant = pcall(function()
                        return instance:IsA("Model") or instance:IsA("BasePart") or instance:IsA("Tool") or instance:IsA("Folder")
                end)
                if okClass and isRelevant and type(instance.Name) == "string" then
                        local key = runtime.keyMap[normalizeName(instance.Name)]
                        if key and (not runtime.data[key] or runtime.generated[key]) then
                                local specs = NoirFX.snapshot(runtime, instance)
                                if #specs > 0 then
                                        runtime.data[key] = specs
                                        runtime.generated[key] = nil
                                        added = added + 1
                                end
                        end
                end
                local okChildren, children = pcall(function() return instance:GetChildren() end)
                if okChildren and type(children) == "table" then
                        for _, child in ipairs(children) do walk(child, depth + 1) end
                end
        end
        for _, container in ipairs(containers) do
                if type(container) == "table" or typeof and typeof(container) == "Instance" then walk(container, 0) end
        end
        return added
end

-- источник 1/2: дамп эффектов (кэш Pulse или наша копия)
NoirFX.loadPulseCache = function(runtime)
        local environment = (runtime.context and runtime.context.environment) or {}
        local readfile, isfile = environment.readfile, environment.isfile
        if type(readfile) ~= "function" then return false end
        local paths = {{FX_PULSE_PATH, true}, {FX_OWN_PATH, false}}
        for index, candidate in ipairs(paths) do
                local path, verified = candidate[1], candidate[2]
                local ok, contents = pcall(function()
                        if verified and type(isfile) == "function" and not isfile(path) then return nil end
                        return readfile(path)
                end)
                if ok and type(contents) == "string" and #contents > 100 then
                        if verified and (#contents ~= FX_PULSE_SIZE or NoirFX.pulseHash(contents) ~= FX_PULSE_HASH) then
                                NoirFX.diag("pulse cache hash mismatch: " .. path)
                        else
                                local parsed = NoirFX.parseLuaLiteral(contents)
                                if type(parsed) ~= "table" and runtime.context.http then
                                        pcall(function() parsed = runtime.context.http:JSONDecode(contents) end)
                                end
                                if type(parsed) == "table" then
                                        local count = 0
                                        for key, specs in pairs(parsed) do
                                                if type(key) == "string" and type(specs) == "table" and not runtime.data[key] then
                                                        runtime.data[key] = specs
                                                        count = count + 1
                                                end
                                        end
                                        if count > 0 then
                                                runtime.sources = runtime.sources .. "dump=" .. count .. " "
                                                NoirFX.diag("loaded " .. count .. " effect specs from " .. path)
                                                return true
                                        end
                                end
                        end
                end
        end
        return false
end

-- источник 3: кэш снайффера с прошлых сессий
NoirFX.loadSniffCache = function(runtime)
        local environment = (runtime.context and runtime.context.environment) or {}
        local readfile, isfile = environment.readfile, environment.isfile
        if type(readfile) ~= "function" then return 0 end
        local ok, payload = pcall(function()
                if type(isfile) == "function" and not isfile(FX_SNIFF_PATH) then return nil end
                return readfile(FX_SNIFF_PATH)
        end)
        if not ok or type(payload) ~= "string" or #payload < 8 then return 0 end
        local added = 0
        pcall(function()
                local decoded = runtime.context.http and runtime.context.http:JSONDecode(payload)
                if type(decoded) == "table" then
                        for key, specs in pairs(decoded) do
                                if type(key) == "string" and type(specs) == "table" and #specs > 0 and not runtime.data[key] then
                                        runtime.data[key] = specs
                                        added = added + 1
                                end
                        end
                end
        end)
        if added > 0 then runtime.sources = runtime.sources .. "sniffCache=" .. added .. " " end
        return added
end

NoirFX.persist = function(runtime)
        local environment = (runtime.context and runtime.context.environment) or {}
        local writefile, isfolder, makefolder = environment.writefile, environment.isfolder, environment.makefolder
        if type(writefile) ~= "function" then return end
        if type(runtime.cache) ~= "table" or not next(runtime.cache) then return end
        pcall(function()
                if type(isfolder) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function" and not isfolder("NoirMM2") then makefolder("NoirMM2") end
                local http = runtime.context.http
                local payload = http and http:JSONEncode(runtime.cache)
                if payload then writefile(FX_SNIFF_PATH, payload) end
        end)
end

-- источник 6: живой снайффер — чужие ножи/дисплеи с настоящими эффектами
NoirFX.learn = function(runtime, knife, handle, character)
        if not handle or type(handle.GetDescendants) ~= "function" then return end
        local key = NoirFX.resolveKey(runtime, knife, handle, character)
        if not key then return end
        if runtime.data[key] and not runtime.generated[key] then return end
        local specs = NoirFX.snapshot(runtime, handle)
        if #specs == 0 then return end
        runtime.data[key] = specs
        runtime.generated[key] = nil
        runtime.cache[key] = specs
        pcall(NoirFX.persist, runtime)
        NoirFX.diag("sniffed effect specs for " .. key .. " (" .. #specs .. " objects)")
        if runtime.current == key then NoirFX.refresh(runtime) end
end

NoirFX.sniffScan = function(runtime)
        local context = runtime.context
        local players = context.players
        if type(players) ~= "table" or type(players.GetPlayers) ~= "function" then return end
        local ok, list = pcall(function() return players:GetPlayers() end)
        if not ok or type(list) ~= "table" then return end
        for _, player in ipairs(list) do
                local character = player and player.Character
                local knife = character and character:FindFirstChild("Knife")
                local handle = knife and knife:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                if handle and NoirFX.hasFx(handle) then
                        NoirFX.learn(runtime, knife, handle, character)
                end
                local reference = character and character:FindFirstChild("DisplayRefKnife")
                local display = reference and reference.Value
                if display and NoirFX.hasFx(display) then
                        NoirFX.learn(runtime, knife, display, character)
                end
        end
end

-- источник 6b: карточки инвентаря игры (Inventory -> Effects). Пока открыта
-- страница Effects, клиент сам строит превью-ножи с НАСТОЯЩИМИ эффектами.
-- Снимаем спеки с превью и привязываем их к имени эффекта по TextLabel
-- карточки; результат сохраняется в NoirMM2/fx_sniff.txt.
NoirFX.resolveUiKey = function(runtime, text)
        if type(text) ~= "string" or #text == 0 or #text > 48 then return nil end
        local norm = normalizeName(text)
        if #norm < 3 then return nil end
        local mapped = runtime.keyMap[norm]
        if mapped then return mapped end
        for candidate, key in pairs(runtime.keyMap) do
                if string.gsub(candidate, "20%d%d$", "") == norm then return key end
        end
        return nil
end

NoirFX.sniffUiCards = function(runtime)
        if type(runtime.keyMap) ~= "table" or not next(runtime.keyMap) then return 0 end
        local context = runtime.context
        local playerGui = context.player
                and type(context.player.FindFirstChild) == "function"
                and context.player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if not playerGui then return 0 end
        local okList, descendants = pcall(function() return playerGui:GetDescendants() end)
        if not okList or type(descendants) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        local added, budget = 0, 500
        for _, instance in ipairs(descendants) do
                if budget <= 0 then break end
                if NoirFX.hasFx(instance) then
                        budget = budget - 1
                        local node, hops, key = instance, 0, nil
                        while node and hops < 7 and not key do
                                local okKids, kids = pcall(function() return node:GetChildren() end)
                                if okKids and type(kids) == "table" then
                                        for _, child in ipairs(kids) do
                                                if key then break end
                                                local okLabel, isLabel = pcall(function() return child:IsA("TextLabel") end)
                                                if okLabel and isLabel then
                                                        local okText, text = pcall(function() return child.Text end)
                                                        if okText then key = NoirFX.resolveUiKey(runtime, text) end
                                                end
                                        end
                                end
                                if not key then
                                        local okDeep, deep = pcall(function() return node:GetDescendants() end)
                                        if okDeep and type(deep) == "table" then
                                                for _, child in ipairs(deep) do
                                                        if key or budget <= 0 then break end
                                                        budget = budget - 1
                                                        local okLabel, isLabel = pcall(function() return child:IsA("TextLabel") end)
                                                        if okLabel and isLabel then
                                                                local okText, text = pcall(function() return child.Text end)
                                                                if okText then key = NoirFX.resolveUiKey(runtime, text) end
                                                        end
                                                end
                                        end
                                end
                                node = node.Parent
                                hops = hops + 1
                        end
                        if key and (not runtime.data[key] or runtime.generated[key]) then
                                local specs = NoirFX.snapshot(runtime, instance)
                                if specs and #specs > 0 then
                                        runtime.data[key] = specs
                                        runtime.generated[key] = nil
                                        runtime.cache[key] = specs
                                        pcall(NoirFX.persist, runtime)
                                        added = added + 1
                                        NoirFX.diag("captured REAL specs for " .. key .. " from game inventory")
                                        if runtime.current == key then NoirFX.refresh(runtime) end
                                end
                        end
                end
        end
        if added > 0 then
                runtime.sources = runtime.sources .. "uiCapture=" .. added .. " "
                pcall(fxNotify, "Сняты настоящие эффекты из инвентаря: +" .. added)
        end
        return added
end

-- источник 7 (v1.8): библиотека визуалов реальных эффектов MM2 — переписана
-- с нуля (fx_lib_v18): принципы как в настоящей игре — мелкие частицы вдоль
-- клинка, свечение клинка, тонкий след, падающие частицы, вспышки. Для новых/
-- неизвестных имён остаётся детерминированный hash-визуал.
NoirFX.hueRGB = function(h, s, v)
        h = (h % 1) * 6
        local c, x = v * s, v * s * (1 - math.abs(h % 2 - 1))
        local m = v - c
        local r, g, b
        if h < 1 then r, g, b = c, x, 0
        elseif h < 2 then r, g, b = x, c, 0
        elseif h < 3 then r, g, b = 0, c, x
        elseif h < 4 then r, g, b = 0, x, c
        elseif h < 5 then r, g, b = x, 0, c
        else r, g, b = c, 0, x end
        return r + m, g + m, b + m
end

NoirFX.craftFallback = function(environment, key)
        local seed = 5381
        for index = 1, #key do seed = (seed * 33 + string.byte(key, index)) % 2147483647 end
        local hue = (seed % 359) / 359
        local flavor = seed % 6
        local function grad(h1, s1, v1, h2, s2, v2)
                local r1, g1, b1 = NoirFX.hueRGB(h1, s1, v1)
                local r2, g2, b2 = NoirFX.hueRGB(h2, s2, v2)
                return {6, 0, r1, g1, b1, 0.55, (r1 + r2) / 2, (g1 + g2) / 2, (b1 + b2) / 2, 1, r2, g2, b2}
        end
        if flavor == 0 then -- аура: искры вокруг клинка + мягкое свечение
                return {
                        {cls = "ParticleEmitter", nm = "NoirAura", Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds", Color = grad(hue, 0.9, 1, (hue + 0.12) % 1, 0.6, 1),
                         LightEmission = 1, LightInfluence = 0, Brightness = 2, Size = {5, 0, 0.15, 0, 0.35, 0.75, 0, 1, 0.05, 0},
                         Transparency = {5, 0, 1, 0, 0.3, 0.1, 0, 1, 1, 0}, Lifetime = {4, 0.7, 1.3}, Rate = 22,
                         Speed = {4, 0, 0.15}, SpreadAngle = {3, 180, 180}, RotSpeed = {4, -140, 140}, ZOffset = 0.2},
                        {cls = "ParticleEmitter", nm = "NoirGlow", Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds", Color = grad(hue, 0.5, 0.7, hue, 0.2, 1),
                         LightEmission = 1, LightInfluence = 0, Size = {5, 0, 0.6, 0, 0.7, 1.1, 0, 1, 1.4, 0},
                         Transparency = {5, 0, 1, 0, 0.55, 0.85, 0, 1, 1, 0}, Lifetime = {4, 0.9, 1.4}, Rate = 8,
                         Speed = {4, 0, 0}, LockedToPart = true, ZOffset = -0.1},
                }
        end
        if flavor == 1 then -- пламя: языки вверх от рукояти
                return {
                        {cls = "ParticleEmitter", nm = "NoirFlame", Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds", Color = grad((hue + 0.05) % 1, 0.85, 0.9, hue, 0.55, 1),
                         LightEmission = 1, LightInfluence = 0, Brightness = 2.5, Size = {5, 0, 0.35, 0, 0.5, 0.7, 0, 1, 0.1, 0},
                         Transparency = {5, 0, 0.25, 0, 0.5, 0.55, 0, 1, 1, 0}, Lifetime = {4, 0.4, 0.8}, Rate = 34,
                         Speed = {4, 0.5, 1.4}, Acceleration = {2, 0, 0, 2.2}, SpreadAngle = {3, 28, 28}, EmissionDirection = {8, "NormalId", "Top"},
                         RotSpeed = {4, -60, 60}, ZOffset = 0.15},
                }
        end
        if flavor == 2 then -- след вдоль клинка + пыль
                return {
                        {cls = "Trail", nm = "NoirTrail", Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds", Color = grad(hue, 0.85, 1, (hue + 0.08) % 1, 0.5, 1),
                         LightEmission = 1, LightInfluence = 0, Transparency = {5, 0, 0.2, 0, 1, 1, 0}, Lifetime = 0.3,
                         WidthScale = {5, 0, 0.55, 0, 1, 0.05, 0}, FaceCamera = true, MinLength = 0,
                         a0CF = {7, 0, 0, 0.55, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1}, a1CF = {7, 0, 0, -0.55, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1}},
                        {cls = "ParticleEmitter", nm = "NoirDust", Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds", Color = grad((hue + 0.5) % 1, 0.7, 1, hue, 0.8, 1),
                         LightEmission = 1, LightInfluence = 0, Size = {5, 0, 0.12, 0, 1, 0.02, 0}, Transparency = {5, 0, 0.4, 0, 1, 1, 0},
                         Lifetime = {4, 0.3, 0.7}, Rate = 14, Speed = {4, 0.05, 0.3}, SpreadAngle = {3, 180, 180}, ZOffset = 0.25},
                }
        end
        if flavor == 3 then -- сферы-светлячки + подсветка
                local r, g, b = NoirFX.hueRGB(hue, 0.6, 1)
                return {
                        {cls = "ParticleEmitter", nm = "NoirOrb", Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds", Color = grad(hue, 0.7, 1, (hue + 0.15) % 1, 0.4, 1),
                         LightEmission = 1, LightInfluence = 0, Size = {5, 0, 0.2, 0, 0.5, 0.5, 0, 1, 0.9, 0},
                         Transparency = {5, 0, 0.5, 0, 0.6, 0.35, 0, 1, 1, 0}, Lifetime = {4, 0.9, 1.7}, Rate = 16,
                         Speed = {4, 0.15, 0.45}, SpreadAngle = {3, 180, 180}, Drag = 1.5, ZOffset = 0.3, RotSpeed = {4, -40, 40}},
                        {cls = "PointLight", nm = "NoirLight", Color = {1, r, g, b}, Brightness = 1.2, Range = 7, Shadows = false},
                }
        end
        if flavor == 4 then -- глитч: стробо-искры
                return {
                        {cls = "ParticleEmitter", nm = "NoirGlitch", Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds", Color = grad(hue, 0.25, 1, (hue + 0.5) % 1, 0.15, 1),
                         LightEmission = 1, LightInfluence = 0, Brightness = 3, Size = {5, 0, 0.28, 0, 0.5, 0.16, 0, 1, 0.02, 0},
                         Transparency = {5, 0, 0.1, 0, 0.6, 0.6, 0, 1, 1, 0}, Lifetime = {4, 0.15, 0.35}, Rate = 55,
                         Speed = {4, 0.1, 0.5}, SpreadAngle = {3, 90, 90}, RotSpeed = {4, -320, 320}, TimeScale = 1.4, ZOffset = 0.2},
                }
        end
        return { -- иней: падающие частицы
                {cls = "ParticleEmitter", nm = "NoirFrost", Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds", Color = grad(hue, 0.2, 1, (hue - 0.05) % 1, 0.35, 0.95),
                 LightEmission = 0.8, LightInfluence = 0, Size = {5, 0, 0.12, 0, 0.45, 0.2, 0, 1, 0.05, 0},
                 Transparency = {5, 0, 0.35, 0, 0.7, 0.35, 0, 1, 1, 0}, Lifetime = {4, 0.8, 1.6}, Rate = 20,
                 Speed = {4, 0.2, 0.6}, Acceleration = {2, 0, 0, -1.4}, SpreadAngle = {3, 180, 180}, ZOffset = 0.2},
        }
end

-- источник 7 (v1.8): библиотека визуалов РЕАЛЬНЫХ эффектов MM2 — переписана с
-- нуля. Принципы как в настоящей игре: узкие мелкие частицы ВДОЛЬ клинка,
-- свечение самого клинка (PointLight), тонкий след Trail у свечений, падающие
-- частицы для снега/лепестков/конфетти, короткие вспышки для электрики.
-- Палитры и поведение взяты со скриншотов игрового инвентаря (Abduction —
-- зелёное свечение, Aurora Lights — сине-фиолетовое сияние, Bloom — розовые
-- лепестки, Nightlife — синее пламя, Smolder — оранжевые угли, Electric Knife —
-- фиолетовая электрика, Cat Eyes — жёлтые глаза в чёрном тумане и т.д.) и
-- официальных описаний эффектов. Названия — реальные из игры
-- (Database.Sync.Effects); для неизвестных имён остаётся hash-визуал
-- (NoirFX.craftFallback).

NoirFX.craftNorm = function(key)
        local norm = string.lower(tostring(key))
        norm = string.gsub(norm, "[%s%(%)_%-'%-]", "")
        return norm
end

                         Transparency = fade(o.tt or 0.4, 1), Lifetime = o.tlife or 0.28, WidthScale = {5, 0, o.tw or 0.35, 0, 1, 0.02, 0},
                         FaceCamera = true, MinLength = 0, a0CF = TIPC, a1CF = GRIPC},
                        {cls = "PointLight", nm = "NoirLight", Color = cA, Brightness = o.lb or 1.5, Range = o.lr or 8},

        local join = function(a, b)
                local out = {}
                for _, s in ipairs(a) do out[#out + 1] = s end
                for _, s in ipairs(b) do out[#out + 1] = s end
                return out
        end
