                        local rwfog = mist(col(255, 80, 80), col(80, 120, 255), {le = 0.6, rate = 8, lb = 1.1})
                        rwfog[1].Color = rainbow()
                        rwfog[2].Color = rainbow()
                        add({"Rainbow"}, join(rwfog, rwdots, rwtrail))
                end
                local fw = join(burst(col(255, 80, 80), col(80, 120, 255), {rate = 10}), twinkle(col(110, 235, 120), col(255, 90, 230), {rate = 12}))
                fw[1].Color = rainbow()
                fw[2].Color = rainbow()
                add({"Fireworks"}, fw)
                local bits = burst(col(255, 80, 80), col(80, 120, 255), {rate = 14, s1 = 0.6})
                bits[1].Color = rainbow()
                add({"Bitsplosion"}, bits)
                local lights = twinkle(col(255, 70, 60), col(110, 235, 120), {rate = 20})
                lights[1].Color = rainbow()
                lights[1].TimeScale = 1.6
                add({"Lights"}, lights)
                local sw = twinkle(col(255, 80, 80), col(80, 120, 255), {rate = 18})
                sw[1].Color = rainbow()
                add({"Swirls", "Candies", "Candies 2022", "Candies (2023)"}, sw)
                local cnd = twinkle(col(255, 80, 80), col(110, 230, 120), {rate = 16, s1 = 0.22})
                add({"Treats"}, join(cnd, fall(col(255, 150, 80), col(160, 90, 40), {rate = 8, s0 = 0.12, s1 = 0.22, le = 0.7})))
        end
        add({"Candy Cane Effect"}, glow(col(255, 70, 70), col(255, 255, 255), {lb = 1.2, rate = 14}))
        add({"Minty"}, glow(col(255, 80, 80), col(255, 255, 255), {lb = 1.2, rate = 16}))
        add({"Stickers"}, glow(col(255, 80, 80), col(110, 230, 120), {lb = 1.2, rate = 14}))
        add({"Gifts"}, glow(col(255, 70, 70), col(110, 230, 120), {lb = 1.3, rate = 12}))
        add({"Gingerbread Effect"}, glow(col(190, 115, 60), col(255, 190, 110), {lb = 1.2, rate = 12}))
        add({"Confetti"}, fall(col(255, 255, 255), col(255, 60, 60), {rate = 22, s0 = 0.08, s1 = 0.18, le = 0.8, sp = 0.5, g = -1.9}))
        add({"Common Ornament"}, glow(col(240, 240, 240), col(255, 255, 255), {lb = 1.1, rate = 12}))
        add({"Rare Ornament"}, glow(col(110, 235, 120), col(60, 200, 90), {lb = 1.2, rate = 12}))
        add({"Uncommon Ornament"}, glow(col(90, 150, 255), col(50, 100, 230), {lb = 1.2, rate = 12}))
        add({"Legendary Ornament"}, glow(col(255, 70, 60), col(220, 40, 35), {lb = 1.4, rate = 12}))
        add({"Strawberries"}, glow(col(240, 50, 70), col(120, 220, 90), {lb = 1.2, rate = 14}))
        add({"Flamingo"}, join(glow(col(255, 130, 190), col(255, 190, 220), {lb = 1.2, rate = 12}), fall(col(255, 150, 190), col(255, 200, 220), {rate = 8, s0 = 0.12, s1 = 0.24, sp = 0.3})))
        add({"Jellyfish"}, glow(col(255, 150, 220), col(120, 200, 255), {lb = 1.3, rate = 12, extra = {
                {cls = "ParticleEmitter", nm = "NoirJelly", Texture = TEXK, Color = rainbow(), LightEmission = 1, LightInfluence = 0, Brightness = 2,
                 Size = nsz(0.1, 0.24, 0.04), Transparency = fade(0.12, 1), Lifetime = nr(0.6, 1.1), Rate = 8,
                 Speed = nr(0.05, 0.3), SpreadAngle = {3, 180, 180}, RotSpeed = nr(-110, 110), ZOffset = 0.2, Drag = 1},
        }}))
        add({"Carrots"}, join(fall(col(255, 145, 40), col(90, 220, 80), {rate = 12, s0 = 0.12, s1 = 0.24}), glow(col(255, 145, 40), col(90, 220, 80), {lb = 1.1, rate = 8})))
        add({"Monify"}, glow(col(110, 230, 120), col(200, 255, 200), {lb = 1, rate = 8, s1 = 0.14, s2 = 0.02}))

        -- ===== особые =========================================================
        add({"Dual Wield"}, {{cls = "Special", fx = "DualWield"}})

        return lib
end
NoirFX.craft = function(environment, key)
        if not NoirFX.lib then NoirFX.lib = NoirFX.buildLib() end
        local norm = NoirFX.craftNorm(key)
        local specs = NoirFX.lib[norm]
        if not specs then
                local stripped = string.gsub(norm, "20%d%d$", "")
                if stripped ~= norm then specs = NoirFX.lib[stripped] end
        end
        if specs then return specs end
        return NoirFX.craftFallback(environment, key)
end

NoirFX.generate = function(runtime)
        local sync = runtime.sync
        local environment = runtime.context and runtime.context.environment
        if type(sync) ~= "table" or type(sync.Effects) ~= "table" or type(environment) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        local added = 0
        for key in pairs(sync.Effects) do
                if type(key) == "string" and #key > 0 and not runtime.data[key] then
                        local ok, specs = pcall(NoirFX.craft, environment, key)
                        if ok and type(specs) == "table" and #specs > 0 then
                                runtime.data[key] = specs
                                runtime.generated[key] = true
                                added = added + 1
                        end
                end
        end
        if added > 0 then
                runtime.sources = runtime.sources .. "generated=" .. added .. " "
                NoirFX.diag("generated " .. added .. " procedural effect specs")
        end
        return added
end

-- пункты меню: отсортированный список ключей + безопасный рефреш дропдауна
NoirFX.menuOptions = function(runtime)
        local labels, keys = { "None" }, {}
        for key in pairs(runtime.data or {}) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
        table.sort(keys)
        for _, key in ipairs(keys) do labels[#labels + 1] = key end
        return labels
end

-- v1.4.3: ключи эффектов напрямую из игры — список в меню НЕ зависит от
-- тоггла и старта рантайма (раньше при падении старта dropdown навсегда
-- оставался с одним «None»: «эффекты не выбираются»)
NoirFX.gameEffectKeys = function(context, environment)
        local ok, sync = pcall(function()
                return environment.require(context.storage:WaitForChild("Database", 15):WaitForChild("Sync", 15))
        end)
        if not ok or type(sync) ~= "table" or type(sync.Effects) ~= "table" then return nil end
        local keys = {}
        for key in pairs(sync.Effects) do
                if type(key) == "string" and #key > 0 then keys[#keys + 1] = key end
        end
        table.sort(keys)
        return keys
end

NoirFX.effectLabels = function(runtime, keys)
        local seen, labels = { None = true }, { "None" }
        local function add(key)
                if type(key) == "string" and #key > 0 and not seen[key] then
                        seen[key] = true
                        labels[#labels + 1] = key
                end
        end
        for _, key in ipairs(keys or {}) do add(key) end
        for key in pairs((type(runtime) == "table" and runtime.data) or {}) do add(key) end
        return labels
end

NoirFX.refreshControl = function(state, runtime)
        if type(state) ~= "table" then return end
        local control = state.fxControl
        if type(control) ~= "table" or type(control.Refresh) ~= "function" then return end
        pcall(function() control:Refresh(NoirFX.menuOptions(runtime), runtime.pinned or "None") end)
end

-- ===== рендер (порт GameEffects.build/targets/refresh/step из Pulse) =====
NoirFX.clear = function(target)
        if not target or type(target.GetDescendants) ~= "function" then return end
        for _, object in ipairs(target:GetDescendants()) do
                local ok, flagged = pcall(function() return object:GetAttribute("NoirFX") end)
                if ok and flagged then pcall(function() object:Destroy() end) end
        end
        -- v1.7: снять прозрачность Ghostify (части ножа) и убрать второй нож
        -- Dual Wield: сканируем от персонажа (тул -> персонаж) или модели дисплея,
        -- потому что второй нож приварен к ЛЕВОЙ руке — уровень персонажа
        local container = target.Parent
        local root = container
        if root and root:IsA("BackpackItem") and root.Parent then root = root.Parent end
        if root and type(root.GetDescendants) == "function" then
                for _, object in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                        pcall(function()
                                if object:GetAttribute("NoirFX") then object:Destroy() end
                        end)
                        pcall(function()
                                local original = object:GetAttribute("NoirFXOrigT")
                                if original ~= nil and object:IsA("BasePart") then
                                        object.Transparency = original
                                        object:SetAttribute("NoirFXOrigT", nil)
                                end
                        end)
                end
        end
end

NoirFX.special = function(runtime, target, spec)
        local kind = tostring(spec.fx or "")
        if kind == "Ghostify" then
                pcall(function()
                        local container = target and target.Parent
                        if container and type(container.GetDescendants) == "function" then
                                for _, part in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
                                        pcall(function()
                                                if part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("NoirFXOrigT") == nil then
                                                        part:SetAttribute("NoirFXOrigT", part.Transparency)
                                                        part.Transparency = 0.55
                                                end
                                        end)
                                end
                        end
                        if target and target:IsA("BasePart") and target:GetAttribute("NoirFXOrigT") == nil then
                                target:SetAttribute("NoirFXOrigT", target.Transparency)
                                target.Transparency = 0.55
                        end
                end)
                return
        end
        if kind == "DualWield" then
                pcall(function()
                        local tool = target and target.Parent
                        local root = tool
                        if root and root:IsA("BackpackItem") and root.Parent then root = root.Parent end
                        if not root or root == tool or root:FindFirstChild("NoirDualKnife") then return end
                        local arm = root:FindFirstChild("Left Arm") or root:FindFirstChild("LeftHand")
                        if not arm or not target:IsA("BasePart") then return end
                        local environment = runtime.context.environment
                        local rightArm = root:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or root:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
                        local grip = rightArm and rightArm:FindFirstChild("RightGrip")
                        local clone = target:Clone()
                        clone.Name = "NoirDualKnife"
                        for _, child in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
                                pcall(function()
                                        if child:GetAttribute("NoirFX") then child:Destroy() end
                                end)
                        end
                        clone:SetAttribute("NoirFX", true)
                        clone.CanCollide = false
                        local weld = environment.Instance.new("Weld")
                        weld.Name = "NoirDualWeld"
                        weld.Part0 = arm
                        weld.Part1 = clone
                        weld.C0 = grip and grip.C0 or environment.CFrame.new(0, -1, 0)
                        weld.C1 = grip and grip.C1 or environment.CFrame.new()
                        clone.Parent = root
                        weld.Parent = clone
                end)
        end
end

NoirFX.build = function(runtime, target, key)
        local data = runtime.data[key]
        if not target or type(data) ~= "table" or #data == 0 then return 0 end
        local environment, count = runtime.context.environment, 0
        for _, spec in ipairs(data) do
                if spec.cls == "Special" then
                        local okSpecial = pcall(function() NoirFX.special(runtime, target, spec) end)
                        if okSpecial then count = count + 1 end
                elseif FX_CLASSES[spec.cls] then
                        local ok = pcall(function()
                                local effect = environment.Instance.new(spec.cls)
                                for property, value in pairs(spec) do
                                        if not FX_RESERVED[property] then
                                                local decoded = decodeTyped(environment, value)
                                                if decoded ~= nil then pcall(function() effect[property] = decoded end) end
                                        end
                                end
                                if type(spec.nm) == "string" and spec.nm ~= "" then effect.Name = spec.nm end
                                effect:SetAttribute("NoirFX", true)
                                if spec.cls == "Trail" or spec.cls == "Beam" then
                                        local first = environment.Instance.new("Attachment")
                                        local second = environment.Instance.new("Attachment")
                                        first:SetAttribute("NoirFX", true)
                                        second:SetAttribute("NoirFX", true)
                                        local c0 = decodeTyped(environment, spec.a0CF)
                                        local c1 = decodeTyped(environment, spec.a1CF)
                                        first.CFrame = c0 or environment.CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.4)
                                        second.CFrame = c1 or environment.CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.4)
                                        first.Parent, second.Parent = target, target
                                        pcall(function() effect.Attachment0, effect.Attachment1 = first, second end)
                                        effect.Parent = target
                                        return
                                end
                                if spec.attCF then
                                        local attachment = environment.Instance.new("Attachment")
                                        attachment:SetAttribute("NoirFX", true)
                                        local cf = decodeTyped(environment, spec.attCF)
                                        attachment.CFrame = cf or environment.CFrame.new()
                                        attachment.Parent = target
                                        effect.Parent = attachment
                                        return
                                end
                                effect.Parent = target
                        end)
                        if ok then count = count + 1 end
                end
        end
        return count
end

NoirFX.targets = function(runtime)
        local context = runtime.context
        local character = context.player and context.player.Character
        local targets = {}
        local knife = character and character:FindFirstChild("Knife")
        local handle = knife and knife:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if handle then targets[#targets + 1] = handle end
        local reference = character and character:FindFirstChild("DisplayRefKnife")
        local display = reference and reference.Value
        local globals = context.environment.getgenv and context.environment.getgenv() or _G
        local skins = globals.__noirWeaponSkins
        local replacement = (skins and skins.knifeTargets and skins.knifeTargets()) or {}
        if replacement.handle then
                if handle then
                        NoirFX.clear(handle)
                        targets[#targets] = replacement.handle
                else
                        targets[#targets + 1] = replacement.handle
                end
        end
        if replacement.display then
                if display then NoirFX.clear(display) end
                display = replacement.display
        end
        if display then targets[#targets + 1] = display end
        return targets
end

NoirFX.refresh = function(runtime)
        local targets, built = NoirFX.targets(runtime), 0
        for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
                NoirFX.clear(target)
                if runtime.current and runtime.current ~= "" then
                        built = built + NoirFX.build(runtime, target, runtime.current)
                end
        end
        if #targets == 0 then
                -- v1.7: нож не в персонаже (Backpack) — снять второй нож Dual Wield
                -- и прозрачность Ghostify, чтобы не висели в воздухе
                local character = runtime.context and runtime.context.player and runtime.context.player.Character
                if character and type(character.GetDescendants) == "function" then
                        for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                                pcall(function()
                                        if object:GetAttribute("NoirFX") then object:Destroy() end
                                end)
                                pcall(function()
                                        local original = object:GetAttribute("NoirFXOrigT")
                                        if original ~= nil and object:IsA("BasePart") then
                                                object.Transparency = original
                                                object:SetAttribute("NoirFXOrigT", nil)
                                        end
                                end)
                        end
                end
        end
        runtime.lastBuilt, runtime.lastTargets = built, #targets
end

NoirFX.unlock = function(runtime)
        local context, environment = runtime.context, runtime.context.environment
        -- v1.4.3: sync и профиль добываются РАЗДЕЛЬНО — сбой одного не роняет
        -- второй; без профиля игры рендер всё равно работает (он локальный)
        if not runtime.sync then
                local ok, err = pcall(function()
                        runtime.sync = environment.require(context.storage:WaitForChild("Database", 10):WaitForChild("Sync", 10))
                end)
                if not ok then
                        runtime.sync = nil
                        NoirFX.diag("unlock sync: " .. tostring(err))
                end
        end
        if not runtime.profile and runtime.sync then
                pcall(function()
                        runtime.profile = environment.require(context.storage:WaitForChild("Modules", 10):WaitForChild("ProfileData", 10))
                end)
        end
        local sync = runtime.sync
        if type(sync) ~= "table" or type(sync.Effects) ~= "table" then
                NoirFX.diag("unlock: effects database not found")
                return false
        end
        -- выдать эффекты в инвентарь игры; сервер может не подтвердить — это
        -- нормально: меню игры строит список из локального профиля
        pcall(function()
                local profile = runtime.profile
                if type(profile) ~= "table" or type(profile.Effects) ~= "table" then
                        NoirFX.diag("unlock: profile.Effects missing — только локальный рендер")
                        return
                end
                local keys = {}
                for key in pairs(sync.Effects) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(key) end
                profile.Effects.Owned = keys
                if not runtime.invRemotes then
                        runtime.invRemotes = context.storage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10):WaitForChild("Inventory", 10)
                end
                local inventory = runtime.invRemotes
                if not inventory then return end
                local changed = inventory:FindFirstChild("InventoryDataChanged")
                if changed then
                        pcall(function() changed:Fire("Effects") end)
                        pcall(function() changed:Fire() end)
                end
                local profileChanged = inventory:FindFirstChild("ProfileDataChanged")
                if profileChanged then pcall(function() profileChanged:Fire() end) end
        end)
        return true
end

NoirFX.step = function(runtime)
        if not runtime.enabled or not runtime.alive then return end
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - runtime.checked >= 0.35 then
                runtime.checked = now
                local profile = runtime.profile
                local equipped = profile and profile.Effects and profile.Effects.Equipped
                local current = nil
                if type(equipped) == "string" then
                        current = equipped
                elseif type(equipped) == "table" then
                        current = equipped[1]
                end
                if type(runtime.pinned) == "string" and runtime.pinned ~= "" then current = runtime.pinned end
                if current ~= runtime.current then
                        runtime.current = current
                        NoirFX.refresh(runtime)
                end
        end
        if now - runtime.repaired >= 0.6 then
                runtime.repaired = now
                if runtime.current and runtime.current ~= "" then
                        for _, target in ipairs(NoirFX.targets(runtime)) do
                                local present = false
                                for _, object in ipairs(target:GetDescendants()) do
                                        local ok, flagged = pcall(function() return object:GetAttribute("NoirFX") end)
                                        if ok and flagged then
                                                present = true
                                                break
                                        end
                                end
                                if not present then NoirFX.build(runtime, target, runtime.current) end
                        end
                end
        end
        if now - runtime.unlockedTick >= 3 then
                runtime.unlockedTick = now
                NoirFX.unlock(runtime)
                NoirFX.rebuildKeyMap(runtime)
        end
        if now - runtime.sniffTick >= 1 then
                runtime.sniffTick = now
                NoirFX.sniffScan(runtime)
                if now - (runtime.uiTick or 0) >= 1.5 then
                        runtime.uiTick = now
                        pcall(NoirFX.sniffUiCards, runtime)
                end
        end
end

-- ===== точка входа (сигнатура и поведение тоггла сохранены) =====
local NoirUnlockEffects = function(state, enabled)
        local globals = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
        local previous = globals.__NoirUnlockEffectsRuntime
        if type(previous) == "table" and type(previous.stop) == "function" then pcall(previous.stop) end
        globals.__NoirUnlockEffectsRuntime = nil
        if not enabled then return end
        local runtime = {
                context = state.context, data = {}, cache = {}, keyMap = {},
                current = nil, enabled = true, alive = true, sources = "",
                lastBuilt = 0, lastTargets = 0, profile = nil, sync = nil,
                generated = {}, pinned = nil, conns = {},
        }
        local now = os.clock()
        runtime.checked, runtime.repaired, runtime.unlockedTick, runtime.sniffTick = now, now, now - 2.8, now
        -- прямой выбор эффекта из меню Noir: пин важнее инвентаря игры
        -- v1.4.3: выбор также пишется в профиль игры и на диск (восстановление
        -- после релога) + уведомление, чтобы выбор не выглядел «нажал и ничего»
        runtime.pin = function(key)
                runtime.pinned = (type(key) == "string" and key ~= "") and key or nil
                runtime.current = runtime.pinned
                pcall(function()
                        local effects = runtime.profile and runtime.profile.Effects
                        if effects and (effects.Equipped == nil or type(effects.Equipped) == "string") then
                                effects.Equipped = runtime.pinned
                        end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                        local env = runtime.context.environment
                        if type(env.writefile) == "function" then
                                if type(env.isfolder) == "function" and type(env.makefolder) == "function" and not env.isfolder("Noir") then env.makefolder("Noir") end
                                local http = runtime.context.http
                                local payload = http and http:JSONEncode({ effect = runtime.pinned or false })
                                if payload then env.writefile("Noir/mm2_fx.json", payload) end
                        end
                end)
                pcall(NoirFX.refresh, runtime)
                if runtime.pinned then
                        fxNotify("Эффект надет (виден только вам): " .. runtime.pinned)
                end
        end
        runtime.stop = function()
                runtime.alive = false
                runtime.enabled = false
                for _, connection in ipairs(runtime.conns) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
                runtime.conns = {}
                pcall(function()
                        for _, target in ipairs(NoirFX.targets(runtime)) do NoirFX.clear(target) end
                end)
        end
        -- база: синк и профиль игры; рендер локальный — работает и без профиля
        if not NoirFX.unlock(runtime) then
                fxNotify("Эффекты: каталог игры не найден, список будет пуст")
        end
        NoirFX.rebuildKeyMap(runtime)
        -- источники спеков (кэши синхронно, скан моделей асинхронно)
        pcall(NoirFX.loadPulseCache, runtime)
        pcall(NoirFX.loadSniffCache, runtime)
        local syncHits = 0
        pcall(function() syncHits = NoirFX.fromSync(runtime) end)
        if syncHits > 0 then runtime.sources = runtime.sources .. "sync=" .. syncHits .. " " end
        NoirFX.rebuildKeyMap(runtime)
        -- источник 7: заполняем процедурными спеками всё, что не дали источники 1-6
        pcall(function() NoirFX.generate(runtime) end)
        -- v1.4.3: вернуть последний выбранный эффект (Noir/mm2_fx.json)
        pcall(function()
                local env = runtime.context.environment
                if type(env.readfile) == "function" and type(env.isfile) == "function" and env.isfile("Noir/mm2_fx.json") then
                        local saved = runtime.context.http and runtime.context.http:JSONDecode(env.readfile("Noir/mm2_fx.json"))
                        local key = type(saved) == "table" and saved.effect or nil
                        if type(key) == "string" and runtime.data[key] and runtime.pin then runtime.pin(key) end
                end
        end)
        pcall(NoirFX.refreshControl, state, runtime)
        pcall(function()
                task.spawn(function()
                        local modelHits = NoirFX.fromModels(runtime)
                        if modelHits > 0 then
                                runtime.sources = runtime.sources .. "models=" .. modelHits .. " "
                                NoirFX.rebuildKeyMap(runtime)
                                NoirFX.refresh(runtime)
                        end
                end)
        end)
        -- первый рендер + циклы
        pcall(NoirFX.refresh, runtime)
        local context = runtime.context
        if context.runService and context.runService.Heartbeat and type(context.connect) == "function" then
                runtime.conns[#runtime.conns + 1] = context.connect(context.runService.Heartbeat, function()
                        pcall(NoirFX.step, runtime)
                end)
        end
        if context.player and context.player.CharacterAdded and type(context.connect) == "function" then
                runtime.conns[#runtime.conns + 1] = context.connect(context.player.CharacterAdded, function()
                        task.delay(0.9, function()
                                if runtime.enabled and runtime.alive then pcall(NoirFX.refresh, runtime) end
                        end)
                end)
        end
        globals.__NoirUnlockEffectsRuntime = runtime
        local total = 0
        for _ in pairs(runtime.data) do total = total + 1 end
        local summary = total > 0 and (total .. " эффектов (" .. runtime.sources .. "визуал локальный; эффект из списка ниже или инвентаря игры)")
                or "список разблокирован, но игра не отдала каталог эффектов — перезайди в лобби и включи снова"
        NoirFX.diag("enabled: " .. summary)
        fxNotify("Noir FX: " .. summary)
        pcall(NoirFX.refreshControl, state, runtime)
        globals.__NoirEffectState = {unlockOn = true, effects = total, sources = runtime.sources}
end

-- ===== Noir NovaUI menu (the in-game inventory
-- "Changer" page comes from the engine itself via installInventory) =====

NoirSkinMenu = function(state)
        task.spawn(function()
                local tab = Core.tab
                if type(tab) ~= "table" or type(tab.AddSection) ~= "function" then
                        pcall(function()
                            local globals = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
                            globals.__NoirSkinsDiag = tostring(globals.__NoirSkinsDiag or "") .. "menu skipped: NovaUI tab not found"
                        end)
                        return
                end
                local ok, menuError = pcall(function()
                        local sectionName = "SKINS \u{2022} WEAPON SKINCHANGER"
                        -- AddToggle fires its callback once at registration with the persisted
                        -- value, so an untouched toggle would call setEnabled(false) and silently
                        -- disable the skinchanger; seed the default ON for the first launch.
                        local persistence = Core.NoirPersistence
                        if type(persistence) == "table" and type(persistence.data) == "table" then
                                local toggles = persistence.data.toggles
                                if type(toggles) ~= "table" then toggles = {}; persistence.data.toggles = toggles end
                                local masterKey = sectionName .. "::Weapon Skin Changer"
                                if toggles[masterKey] == nil then
                                        toggles[masterKey] = true
                                        if type(persistence.Save) == "function" then pcall(persistence.Save) end
                                end
                        end
                        local section = tab:AddSection(sectionName,
                                "Full engine \u{2022} 380+ skins \u{2022} effects, hold animations, thrown knives, lobby display \u{2022} pick skins in your inventory too")

                        section:AddToggle("Weapon Skin Changer", function(value)
                                pcall(WeaponSkins.setEnabled, state, value)
                        end)
                        section:AddToggle("Knife On Belt", function(value)
                                state.knifeBelt = value == true
                                pcall(WeaponSkins.clearDisplay, state, "Knife")
                                if state.ready then
                                        task.spawn(function() pcall(WeaponSkins.applyDisplay, state, "Knife") end)
                                end
                        end)
                        section:AddButton("Reset To Real", function()
                                pcall(WeaponSkins.resetSlot, state, "Knife")
                                pcall(WeaponSkins.resetSlot, state, "Gun")
                        end)
                        -- NOIR v1.4 (Pulse): выдача всех эффектов игры — возле скинченджера
                        section:AddLabel("GAME EFFECTS")
                        section:AddToggle("Unlock All Effects (game menu)", function(value)
                                pcall(NoirUnlockEffects, state, value == true)
                        end)
                        -- v1.4.3: выбор эффекта. Список наполняется ПРЯМО ИЗ ИГРЫ при
                        -- построении меню — раньше он наполнялся только из рантайма
                        -- тоггла и оставался «None», если старт падал/откладывался.
                        -- Выбор работает даже с выключенным тогглом (рантайм стартует
                        -- сам); визуал локальный, подтверждение сервера не нужно.
                        state.fxControl = section:AddDropdown("Game Effect (visual)", { "None" }, function(label)
                                pcall(function()
                                        local globals = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
                                        local runtime = globals.__NoirUnlockEffectsRuntime
                                        if label == "None" then
                                                if runtime and runtime.pin then runtime.pin(nil) end
                                                return
                                        end
                                        if not runtime then
                                                pcall(NoirUnlockEffects, state, true)
                                                runtime = globals.__NoirUnlockEffectsRuntime
                                        end
                                        if runtime and runtime.pin then
                                                runtime.pin(label)
                                        else
                                                fxNotify("Не вышло: включите Unlock All Effects и выберите снова")
                                        end
                                end)
                        end)
                        pcall(function()
                                local runtime = getgenv and getgenv().__NoirUnlockEffectsRuntime
                                if runtime then pcall(NoirFX.refreshControl, state, runtime) end
                        end)
                        -- немедленное наполнение списка эффектов из Database.Sync.Effects
                        pcall(function()
                                task.spawn(function()
                                        local context = state.context
                                        local environment = context and context.environment or {}
                                        local keys = NoirFX.gameEffectKeys(context, environment)
                                        if type(keys) == "table" and #keys > 0 then
                                                local globals = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
                                                local runtime = globals.__NoirUnlockEffectsRuntime
                                                local labels = NoirFX.effectLabels(runtime, keys)
                                                local current = (type(runtime) == "table" and type(runtime.pinned) == "string" and runtime.pinned) or "None"
                                                local control = state.fxControl
                                                if type(control) == "table" and type(control.Refresh) == "function" then
                                                        control:Refresh(labels, current)
                                                end
                                        end
                                end)
                        end)

                        section:AddDropdown("Skin Type", { "All", "Knife", "Gun" }, function(value)
                                state.kind = value or "All"
                        end)
                        section:AddDropdown("Skin Rarity", { "Any", "Noir", "Ancient", "Godly", "Chroma", "Unique", "Classic", "Legendary", "Rare" }, function(value)
                                state.rarity = value or "Any"
                        end)
                        section:AddTextBox("Search skins", function(value)
                                state.query = tostring(value or "")
                        end)

                        local labelToKey = {}
                        local function currentLabel()
                                if not state.ready then return nil end
                                local key = state.selected.Knife or state.selected.Gun
                                if not key then return nil end
                                for label, candidate in pairs(labelToKey) do
                                        if candidate == key then return label end
                                end
                                return nil
                        end
                        local function buildOptions()
                                labelToKey = { None = nil }
                                local labels = { "None" }
                                local items = SkinCatalog.filter(state.list or {}, state.kind, state.rarity, state.query)
                                for _, item in ipairs(items) do
                                        local label = item.name .. " \u{2022} " .. tostring(item.type) .. " \u{2022} " .. tostring(item.rarity)
                                        labelToKey[label] = item.key
                                        labels[#labels + 1] = label
                                end
                                return labels
                        end
                        local skinCtl = section:AddDropdown("Skin", { "None" }, function(label)
                                local key = labelToKey[label]
                                if not key or not state.ready then return end
                                local skin = state.DB[key]
                                if not skin then return end
                                if state.profile.Weapons.Equipped[skin.t] == key and key ~= state.realName[skin.t] then
                                        pcall(WeaponSkins.resetSlot, state, skin.t)
                                        return
                                end
                                pcall(WeaponSkins.equip, state, key)
                        end)

                        -- fill the catalog once the database finishes loading
                        for _ = 1, 150 do
                                if state.ready then break end
                                if not isAlive() then return end
                                task.wait(0.2)
                        end
                        if state.ready then
                                skinCtl:Refresh(buildOptions(), currentLabel() or "None")
                        end
                end)
                if not ok then
                        pcall(function()
                            local globals = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
                            globals.__NoirSkinsDiag = tostring(globals.__NoirSkinsDiag or "") .. "menu failed"
                        end)
                end
        end)
end

-- ===== bootstrap =====

local okInstall, installState, destroySkins = pcall(WeaponSkins.install, context)
if not okInstall or type(installState) ~= "table" then
        pcall(function()
            local globals = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
            globals.__NoirSkinsDiag = tostring(globals.__NoirSkinsDiag or "") .. "engine install failed"
        end)
        return
end
if type(destroySkins) == "function" then
        local previousDestroy = destroySkins
        destroySkins = function(...)
                __alive = false
                return previousDestroy(...)
        end
end
NoirGenv().__NoirSkinsDestroy = destroySkins
]==]

local function __noirSkinsDiag(message)
        pcall(function()
                local globals = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
                globals.__NoirSkinsDiag = tostring(globals.__NoirSkinsDiag or "") .. message
        end)
end

task.defer(function()
        local compiler = loadstring
        if type(compiler) ~= "function" then
                __noirSkinsDiag("loadstring is unavailable; skinchanger skipped\n")
                return
        end
        local okCompile, module = pcall(compiler, __noirSkinSource)
        if not okCompile or type(module) ~= "function" then
                __noirSkinsDiag("compile failed\n")
                return
        end
        local okRun, err = xpcall(module, function(message) return tostring(message) end)
        if not okRun then
                __noirSkinsDiag("startup failed: " .. tostring(err) .. "\n")
        end
end)

if __NOIR_SHARED[__NOIR_GUARD_KEY] == __NOIR_GUARD then
    __NOIR_GUARD.state = "running"
    __NOIR_GUARD.startedAt = os.clock()
    __NOIR_GUARD.heartbeat = os.clock()
    task.spawn(function()
        while __NOIR_SHARED[__NOIR_GUARD_KEY] == __NOIR_GUARD and __NOIR_GUARD.state == "running" do
            __NOIR_GUARD.heartbeat = os.clock()
            task.wait(15)
        end
    end)
end
